1386.g: ਏਕ ਪਾਵ ਤਜਿ ਜੁਧ ਨ ਭਾਜਾ ॥
1386.t: ek paav taj judh na bhaajaa ||

1386.g: ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲ ਪੁਨਿ ਜਿਯ ਮੈ ਕੋਪਾ ॥
1386.t: mahaa kaal pun jiy mai kopaa ||

1386.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਬਿਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਰਥ ਚਕ੍ਰ ॥
1386.t: dhuhoo(n) bisikh kar dhavai rath chakr ||

1386.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਦਏ ਛਿਨ ਇਕ ਮੈ ਬਕ੍ਰ ॥
1386.t: kaaT dhe chhin ik mai bakr ||

1386.g: ਮਾਰ ਦਏ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੇ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੩੭੩॥
1386.t: maar dhe sabh jag ke raajaa ||373||

1386.g: ਦੁਤਿਯ ਬਾਨ ਸੌ ਦੋਊ ਅਰਿ ਕਰ ॥
1386.t: dhutiy baan sau dhouoo ar kar ||

1386.e: Speech of the poet.
Chaupai
Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands
all the desires of my heart be fulfilled.
Let my mind rest under Thy Feet
Sustain me, considering me Thine own.377.
Destroy, O Lord! all my enemies and
protect me with Thine own Hands.
May my family live in comfort
and ease alongwith all my servants and disciples.378.

1386.g: ਮੋ ਰੱਛਾ ਨਿਜ ਕਰ ਦੈ ਕਰਿਯੈ ॥
1386.t: mo ra'chhaa nij kar dhai kariyai ||
1386.e: Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands
and destroy this day all my enemies
May all the aspirations be fulfilled
Let my thirst for Thy Name remain afresh.379.

1386.g: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਧਿਯਾਊਂ ॥
1386.t: tumeh chhaadd koiee avar na dhiyaauoo(n) ||
1386.e: I may remember none else except Thee

1386.g: ਜੋ ਬਰ ਚਹੋਂ ਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਊਂ ॥
1386.t: jo bar chaho(n) su tum te paauoo(n) ||
1386.e: And obtain all the required boons from Thee
Let my servants and disciples cross the world-ocean
All my enemies be singled out and killed.380.
Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands and
relieve me form the fear of death
May Thou ever Bestow Thy favours on my side
Protect me O Lord! Thou, the Supreme Destroyer.381.
Protect me, O Protector Lord!
Most dear, the Protector of the Saints:
Friend of poor and the Destroyer of the enemies

1386.g: ਤੁਮ ਹੋ ਪੁਰੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਕੰਤਾ ॥੩੮੨॥
1386.t: tum ho puree chatur dhas ka(n)taa ||382||
1386.e: Thou art the Master of the fourteen worlds.382.
In due time Brahma appeared in physical form
In due time Shiva incarnated
In due time Vishnu manifested himself
All this is the play of the Temporal Lord.383.
The Temporal Lord, who created Shiva, the Yogi
Who created Brahma, the Master of the Vedas
The Temporal Lord who fashioned the entire world
I salute the same Lord.384.
The Temporal Lord, who created the whole world
Who created gods, demons and yakshas
He is the only one form the beginning to the end
I consider Him only my Guru.385.
I salute Him, non else, but Him
Who has created Himself and His subject
He bestows Divine virtues and happiness on His servants

1386.g: ਸਤੱ੍ਰੁਨ ਕੋ ਪਲ ਮੋ ਬਧ ਕੀਓ ॥੩੮੬॥
1386.t: sata'run ko pal mo badh keeo ||386||
1386.e: He destroys the enemies instantly.386.

1387.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਜਾਨਤ ॥
1387.t: ghaT ghaT ke a(n)tar kee jaanat ||
1387.e: He knows the inner feelings of every heart
He knows the anguish of both good and bad
From the ant to the solid elephant

1387.g: ਸਭ ਪਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰ ਫੂਲਾ ॥੩੮੭॥
1387.t: sabh par kirapaa dhirasaT kar foolaa ||387||
1387.e: He casts His Graceful glance on all and feels pleased.387.
He is painful, when He sees His saints in grief
He is happy, when His saints are happy.
He knows the agony of everyone

1387.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕੇ ਪਟ ਪਟ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈਂ ॥੩੮੮॥
1387.t: ghaT ghaT ke paT paT kee jaanai(n) ||388||
1387.e: He knows the innermost secrets of every heart.388.
When the Creator projected Himself,
His creation manifested itself in innumerable forms
When at any time He withdraws His creation,

1387.g: ਤੁਮ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਤ ਦੇਹ ਧਰ ਸਭਹੂੰ ॥੩੮੯॥
1387.t: tum mai milat dheh dhar sabhahoo(n) ||389||
1387.e: all the physical forms are merged in Him.389.
All the bodies of living beings created in the world
speak about Him according to their understanding
But Thou, O Lord! live quite apart from everything
this fact is know to the Vedas and the learned.390.
The Lord is Formless, Sinless and shelterless:
He is the Primal Power, without Blemish, without Beginning and Unborn
The fool claims boastfully about the knowledge of His secrets,

1387.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਭੇਵ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਬੇਦਾ ॥੩੯੧॥
1387.t: jaa ko bhev na paavat bedhaa ||391||
1387.e: which even the Vedas do not know.391.
The fool considers Him a stone,

1387.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੂੜ੍ਹ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ॥
1387.t: mahaa mooRh kachh bhedh na jaanat ||
1387.e: but the great fool does not know any secret
He calls Shiva “The Eternal Lord",
“but he does not know the secret of the Formless Lord.392.
According to ones own intellect,
one describes Thee differently
The limits of Thy creation cannot be known
and how the world was fashioned in the beginning?393.
He hath only one unparalleled Form
He manifests Himself as a poor man or a king at different places
He created creatures from eggs, wombs and perspiration
Then He created the vegetable kingdom.394.
Somewhere He sits joyfully as a king
Somewhere He contracts Himself as Shiva, the Yogi
All His creation unfolds wonderful things
He, the Primal Power, is from the beginning and Self-Existent.395.
O Lord! keep me now under Thy protection
Protect my disciples and destroy my enemies
All the villains creations outrage
and all the infidels be destroyed in the battlefield.396.
O Supreme Destroyer! those who sought Thy refuge,

1387.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਸ਼ਟ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਮਰੇ ॥
1387.t: tin ke dhushaT dhukhit havai mare ||
1387.e: their enemies met painful death
The persons who fell at Thy Feet,

1387.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭ ਟਾਰੇ ॥੩੯੭॥
1387.t: tin ke tum sa(n)kaT sabh Taare ||397||
1387.e: thou didst remove all their troubles.397.

1387.g: ਜੋ ਕਲਿ ਕੋ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ਧਿਐ ਹੈ ॥
1387.t: jo kal ko ik baar dhiaai hai ||
1387.e: Those who meditate even on the Supreme Destroyer,

1387.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਲ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹਿ ਐਹੈ ॥
1387.t: taa ke kaal nikaT neh aaihai ||
1387.e: death cannot approach them.
They remain protected at all times
Their enemies and troubles come to and end instantly.398.

1388.e: Upon whomsoever Thou dost cast Thy favourable glance,
they are absolved of sins instantly

1388.g: ਰਿੱਧਿ ਸਿੱਧਿ ਘਰ ਮੋ ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
1388.t: ri'dh si'dh ghar mo sabh hoiee ||
1388.e: They have all the worldly and spiritual pleasures in their homes

1388.g: ਦੁਸ਼ਟ ਛਾਹ ਛ੍ਵੈ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩੯੯॥
1388.t: dhushaT chhaeh chhavai sakai na koiee ||399||
1388.e: None of their enemies can even touch their shadow.399.
He, who remembered Thee even once,
thou didst protect him from the noose of death
Those persons, who repeated Thy Name,
they were saved from poverty and attacks of enemies.400.
O Immortal Being (with the sword on Your banner)! I am under Your protection.
Give me Your hand and save me.
Stand by me everywhere,
and guard me against enmity and pain. 401.
The Mother of the world has been kind towards me
and I have completed the book this auspicious night
The Lord is the destroyer of all the sins of the body
and all the malicious and wicked persons.402.
When Mahakal became kind,
he immediately caused me to complete this book
He will obtain the fruit desired by the mind (who will read or listen to this book)
and no suffering will occur to him.403.
ARRIL

1388.g: ਸੁਨੈ ਗੁੰਗ ਜੋ ਯਾਹਿ ਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
1388.t: sunai gu(n)g jo yaeh su rasanaa paaviee ||
1388.e: The dumb, who will listen to it, will be blessed with the tongue to speak

1388.g: ਸੁਨੈ ਮੂੜ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਇ ਚਤੁਰਤਾ ਆਵਈ ॥
1388.t: sunai mooR chit lai chaturataa aaviee ||
1388.e: The fool, who will listen to it attentively, will get wisdom

1388.g: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭੌ ਨਿਕਟ ਨ ਤਿਨ ਨਰ ਕੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
1388.t: dhookh dharadh bhau nikaT na tin nar ke rahai ||
1388.e: That person will be absolved of suffering, pain or fear,

1388.g: ਹੋ ਜੋ ਯਾ ਕੀ ਏਕ ਬਾਰ ਚੌਪਈ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥੪੦੪॥
1388.t: ho jo yaa kee ek baar chauapiee ko kahai ||404||
1388.e: Who will even once recite this Chaupai-prayer.404.
CHAUPAI
It was Bikrami Samvat 1753

1388.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ੍ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਚਾਰ ਸੌ ਪਾਂਚ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੪੦੫॥੭੫੫੮॥ ਅਫਜੰੂ ॥
1388.t: eit sree charitr pakhayaane tirayaa charitre ma(n)tree bhoop sa(n)baadhe chaar sau paa(n)ch charitr samaapatam sat subham sat ||405||7558|| afaja(n)oo ||
1388.e: This book was completed on the banks of Sutlej on Sunday, the eighth Sudi of the month of Bhadon.

1389.e: The Victory is of the Lord.
The Lord is One and His Word is True.
The Sacred Utterance of the Tenth Sovereign.
The Lord is perfect in all faculties. He is Immortal and generous. He is the Giver of victuals and Emancipator.1.
He is the Protector and Helper.

1389.g: ਰਜ਼ਾ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਹੋ ਦਿਲ ਪਜ਼ੀਰ ॥੨॥
1389.t: razaa bakhhash rozee dhiho dhil pazeer ||2||
1389.e: He is Compassionate, the Giver of food, and Enticer.2.
He is the Sovereign, treasure-house of qualities and Guide
He is unparalleled and is without Form and Colour.3.

1389.g: ਨ ਸਾਜ਼ੋ ਨ ਬਾਜ਼ੋ ਨ ਫ਼ੌਜੋ ਨ ਫ਼ਰਸ਼ ॥
1389.t: n saazo na baazo na phauajo na pharash ||

1389.e: Through His Generosity, He provides Heavenly Enjoyments to one without any wealth, falcon, army property and authority.4.
He is the Transcendent as well as Immanent

1389.g: ਅਤਾ ਮੇ ਦਿਹਦ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਹਾਜ਼ਿਰ ਹਜ਼ੂਰ ॥੫॥
1389.t: ataa me dhihadh ham ch haazir hazoor ||5||
1389.e: He is Omnipresent and bestows honours.5.
He is Holy, Generous and Preserver

1389.g: ਰਹੀਮ ਅਸਤੋ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਹੋ ਹਰ ਦਿਯਾਰ ॥੬॥
1389.t: raheem asato rozee dhiho har dhiyaar ||6||
1389.e: He is Merciful and Provider of victuals.6.

1389.g: ਕਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਿਆਰ ਅਸਤੁ ਆਜ਼ਮ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1389.t: k saahib dhiaar asat aazam azeem ||
1389.e: The Lord is Generous, the Highest of the High

1390.g: ਕਿ ਹੁਸਨੁਲ ਜਮਾਲ ਅਸਤੁ ਰਾਜ਼ਕ ਰਹੀਮ ॥੭॥
1390.t: k husanul jamaal asat raazak raheem ||7||
1390.e: He, the preserver, is Most Beautiful.7.

1390.g: ਕਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸ਼ਊਰ ਅਸਤੁ ਆਜਿਜ਼ ਨਿਵਾਜ਼ ॥
1390.t: k saahib shuoor asat aajiz nivaaz ||
1390.e: The Lord is Omniscient, the Protector of the lowly
He, the Friend of the poor, is the Destroyer of the enemies.8.
He is the Source of all virtues, keeper of Dharma
He knows everything and is the Source of all Scriptures.9.
He is the Perfect Being and Treasure of Wisdom
He, the All-Pervading Lord, is Omniscient.10.
The Lord of the Universe, Knows all the sciences and breaks the knots of all complications.11.
He, the Supreme and Most High, Supervises the whole world
He, the Sovereign of the Universe, is the Source of all Learning.12.
(Aurangzeb!) I do not have faith in your oaths.
The Lord Himself is the Witness.13.

1390.g: ਕਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀ ਵ ਦੀਵਾ ਹਮਹ ਕਿਜ਼ਬਗੋਸ਼ਤ ॥੧੪॥
1390.t: k bakhhashee v dheevaa hameh kizabagoshat ||14||
1390.e: I have not an iota of faith in such a person, whose officers have relinquished the path of Truth.14.

1390.g: ਹਮਾ ਰੋਜ਼ਿ ਆਖ਼ਿਰ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਮਰਦ ਖ਼੍ਵਾਰ ॥੧੫॥
1390.t: hamaa roz aakhhir shavadh maradh khhavaiaar ||15||
1390.e: Whosoever puts faith on the oath of Quran, he is subjected to punishment on the final reckoning.15.

1390.g: ਹੁਮਾ ਰਾ ਕਸੇ ਸਾਯਹ ਆਯਦ ਬਜ਼ੇਰ ॥
1390.t: humaa raa kase saayeh aayadh bazer ||

1390.g: ਬਰੋ ਦਸਤ ਦਾਰਦ ਨ ਜ਼ਾਗ਼ੋ ਦਲੇਰ ॥੧੬॥
1390.t: baro dhasat dhaaradh na zaag(h)o dhaler ||16||
1390.e: He, who comes under the shade of the legendary Huma, a very brave crow cannot harm him.16.

1390.g: ਕਸੇ ਪੁਸ਼ਤ ਉਫ਼ਤਦ ਪਸੇ ਸ਼ੇਰਿ ਨਰ ॥
1390.t: kase pushat uphatadh pase sher nar ||
1390.e: He, who takes refuge of the fierce tiger
The goat, sheep and deer do not go near him.17.

1390.g: ਕਸਮ ਮੁਸਹਫ਼ੇ ਖ਼ੁਫ਼ੀਯਹ ਗਰ ਈਂ ਖ਼ੁਰਮ ॥
1390.t: kasam musahaphe khhupheeyeh gar iee(n) khhuram ||

1390.g: ਨ ਫ਼ੌਜੇ ਅਜ਼ੀਂ ਜ਼ੇਰ ਸੁਮ ਅਫ਼ਕੁਨਮ ॥੧੮॥
1390.t: n phauaje azee(n) zer sum aphakunam ||18||
1390.e: Even if I had taken an oath on Quran in concealment, I would not have moved an inch from my place.18.

1390.g: ਗੁਰਸਨਹ ਚਿ ਕਾਰੇ ਕੁਨਦ ਚਿਹਲ ਨਰ ॥
1390.t: gursaneh ch kaare kunadh chihal nar ||

1390.g: ਕਿ ਦਹ ਲਖ ਬਰਆਯਦ ਬਰੋ ਬੇਖ਼ਬਰ ॥੧੯॥
1390.t: k dheh lakh baraayadh baro bekhhabar ||19||
1390.e: How could forty famished persons fight in the battlefield, on whom 1,000,000 soldiers made a sudden attack.19.
Your army breaking the oath and in great haste plunged in the battlefield with arrows and guns.20.
For this reason, I had to intervene and had to come fully armed.21.

1390.g: ਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਅਜ਼ ਹਮਹ ਹੀਲਤੇ ਦਰ ਗੁਜ਼ਸ਼ਤ ॥
1390.t: ch kaar az hameh heelate dhar guzashat ||
1390.e: When all other methods of communication have failed,

1390.g: ਹਲਾਲ ਅਸਤੁ ਬੁਰਦਨ ਬ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ੇਰ ਦਸਤ ॥੨੨॥
1390.t: halaal asat buradhan b shamasher dhasat ||22||
1390.e: It is righteous to take the sword in hand.22.

1390.g: ਚਿ ਕਸਮੇ ਕੁਰਾ ਮਨ ਕੁਨਮ ਏਤਬਾਰ ॥
1390.t: ch kasame kuraa man kunam etabaar ||
1390.e: I have no faith in your oaths on the Quran.

1390.g: ਵਗਰਨਹ ਤੁ ਗੋਈ ਮਨ ਈਂ ਰਹ ਚਿ ਕਾਰ ॥੨੩॥
1390.t: vagaraneh ta goiee man iee(n) reh ch kaar ||23||
1390.e: Otherwise I had nothing to do with this battle.23.

1390.g: ਨ ਦਾਨਮ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਮਰਦ ਰੋਬਾਹ ਪੇਚ ॥
1390.t: n dhaanam k iee(n) maradh robaeh pech ||
1390.e: I did not think your officers would be deceitful.
Otherwise I would not have followed the path I have taken.24.

1390.g: ਹਰ ਆਂ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਕਉਲੇ ਕੁਰਾ ਆਯਦਸ਼ ॥
1390.t: har aa(n) kas k kaule kuraa aayadhash ||
1390.e: For those persons who have put their faith on the oaths of the Quran,
It is not right to imprison and kill them.25.
The soldiers of your army, clad in black uniforms, rushed like flies on my men.

1390.g: ਬ ਯਕ ਬਾਰਗੀ ਦਰ ਖ਼ਰੋਸ਼ ਆਮਦੰਦ ॥੨੬॥
1390.t: b yak baaragee dhar khharosh aamadha(n)dh ||26||
1390.e: They came at us making loud noises.26.

1390.g: ਹਰ ਆਂ ਕਸ ਜ਼ਿ ਦੀਵਾਰ ਆਮਦ ਬਿਰੂੰ ॥
1390.t: har aa(n) kas z dheevaar aamadh biroo(n) ||
1390.e: Whosoever appeared near the wall of the fort,

1390.g: ਬਖ਼ੁਰਦਨ ਯਕੇ ਤੀਰ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਗ਼ਰਕਿ ਖ਼ੂੰ ॥੨੭॥
1390.t: bakhhuradhan yake teer shudh g(h)rak khhoo(n) ||27||
1390.e: With one arrow he was drenched in his own blood.27.

1390.g: ਕਿ ਬੇਰੂੰ ਨਯਾਮਦ ਕਸੇ ਜ਼ਾ ਦੀਵਾਰ ॥
1390.t: k beroo(n) nayaamadh kase zaa dheevaar ||
1390.e: Thereafter, no one dared to come there near the wall

1390.g: ਨ ਖ਼ੁਰਦੰਦ ਤੀਰੋ ਨ ਗਸ਼ਤੰਦ ਖ਼੍ਵਾਰ ॥੨੮॥
1390.t: n khhuradha(n)dh teero na gashata(n)dh khhavaiaar ||28||
1390.e: None faced then the arrows and destruction.28.

1390.g: ਚੁ ਦੀਦਮ ਕਿ ਨਾਹਰ ਬਿਯਾਮਦ ਬ ਜੰਗ ॥
1390.t: ch dheedham k naahar biyaamadh b ja(n)g ||
1390.e: When I saw Nahar Khan in the battlefield,
He was greeted with one of my arrows.29.
All those boasters who came near the wall, they were dispatched in no time.30.

1391.g: ਚੁ ਸੈਲੇ ਰਵਾ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਤੀਰੋ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥੩੧॥
1391.t: ch saile ravaa ham ch teero tupha(n)g ||31||
1391.e: Another Afghan, with a bow and arrow came in the battlefield like a flood.31.

1391.g: ਬਸੇ ਹਮਲਹ ਕਰਦੰਦ ਬ ਮਰਦਾਨਗੀ ॥
1391.t: base hamaleh karadha(n)dh b maradhaanagee ||

1391.g: ਹਮ ਅਜ਼ ਹੋਸ਼ਗੀ ਹਮ ਜ਼ਿ ਦੇਵਾਨਗੀ ॥੩੨॥
1391.t: ham az hoshagee ham z dhevaanagee ||32||
1391.e: He shot arrows heroically, sometimes in senses and sometimes in madness.32.

1391.g: ਬਸੇ ਹਮਲਹ ਕਰਦਹ ਬਸੇ ਜ਼ਖ਼ਮ ਖ਼ੁਰਦ ॥
1391.t: base hamaleh karadheh base zakhham khhuradh ||

1391.g: ਦੁ ਕਸ ਰਾ ਬਜ਼ਾ ਕੁਸ਼ਤੋ ਹਮ ਜਾ ਸਪੁਰਦ ॥੩੩॥
1391.t: dh kas raa bazaa kushato ham jaa sapuradh ||33||
1391.e: He made several attacks and was drenched with last.33.

1391.g: ਕਿ ਆਂ ਖ਼੍ਵਾਜਹ ਮਰਦੂਦ ਸਾਯਹ ਦੀਵਾਰ ॥
1391.t: k aa(n) khhavaiaajeh maradhoodh saayeh dheevaar ||
1391.e: Khwaja Mardud hid himself behind the wall

1391.g: ਨ੍ਰਯਾਮਦ ਬ ਮੈਦਾ ਬ ਮਰਦਾਨਹ ਵਾਰ ॥੩੪॥
1391.t: nrayaamadh b maidhaa b maradhaaneh vaar ||34||
1391.e: He did not enter the field like a brave warrior.34.

1391.g: ਦਰੇਗਾ ਅਗਰ ਰੂਇ ਓ ਦੀਦਮੇ ॥
1391.t: dharegaa agar rooi o dheedhame ||

1391.g: ਬ ਯਕ ਤੀਰ ਲਾਚਾਰ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦਮੇ ॥੩੫॥
1391.t: b yak teer laachaar bakhhasheedhame ||35||
1391.e: If I had seen his face once, one of my arrows would have dispatched him to the abode of death.35.

1391.g: ਹਮਾਖ਼ਿਰ ਬਸੇ ਜ਼ਖ਼ਮਿ ਤੀਰੋ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥
1391.t: hamaakhhir base zakhham teero tupha(n)g ||

1391.g: ਦੁ ਸੂਏ ਬਸੇ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਹ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਬੇਦਰੰਗ ॥੩੬॥
1391.t: dh sooe base kushateh shudh bedhara(n)g ||36||
1391.e: Many warriors wounded with arrows and bullets died in the battle on both the sides.36.

1391.g: ਬਸੇ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰੀਦ ਤੀਰੋ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥
1391.t: base baar baareedh teero tupha(n)g ||

1391.g: ਜ਼ਿਮੀ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਹਮ ਚੂੰ ਗੁਲੇ ਲਾਲਹ ਰੰਗ ॥੩੭॥
1391.t: zimee gashat ham choo(n) gule laaleh ra(n)g ||37||
1391.e: The darts were showered so violently, that the field became red like popyflowers.37.

1391.g: ਸਰੋਪਾਇ ਅੰਬੋਹ ਚੰਦਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ॥
1391.t: saropai a(n)boh cha(n)dhaa shudheh ||

1391.g: ਕਿ ਮੈਦਾ ਪੁਰ ਅਜ਼ ਗੋਇ ਚੌਗਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ॥੩੮॥
1391.t: k maidhaa pur az goi chauagaa shudheh ||38||
1391.e: The heads and limbs of the dead were scattered in the field like the balls and sticks in the game of Polo.38.

1391.g: ਤਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਤੀਰੋ ਤਰੰਗਿ ਕਮਾ ॥
1391.t: tara(n)kaar teero tara(n)g kamaa ||

1391.g: ਬਰਆਮਦ ਯਕੇ ਹਾ ਇ ਹੂ ਅਜ਼ ਜਹਾ ॥੩੯॥
1391.t: baraamadh yake haa i hoo az jahaa ||39||
1391.e: When the arrows hissed and bows tinkled, there was a great hue and cry in the world.39.

1391.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਸ਼ੋਰਸ਼ਿ ਕੈਬਰਿ ਕੀਨਹ ਕੋਸ਼ ॥
1391.t: dhig(h)r shorash kaibar keeneh kosh ||

1391.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਮਰਦਾ ਬਿਰੂੰ ਰਫ਼ਤ ਹੋਸ਼ ॥੪੦॥
1391.t: z maradhaan maradhaa biroo(n) raphat hosh ||40||
1391.e: There the spears and lances provided a dreadful sound and the warriors lost heir senses.40.

1391.g: ਹਮ ਆਖ਼ਿਰ ਚਿ ਮਰਦੀ ਕੁਨਦ ਕਾਰਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1391.t: ham aakhhir ch maradhee kunadh kaarazaar ||

1391.g: ਕਿ ਬਰ ਚਿਹਲ ਤਨ ਆਯਦਸ਼ ਬੇਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ॥੪੧॥
1391.t: k bar chihal tan aayadhash beshumaar ||41||
1391.e: How could bravery ultimately withstand in the field, when only forty were surrounded by innumerable warriors?41.

1391.g: ਚਰਾਗ਼ਿ ਜਹਾ ਚੂੰ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਬੁਰਕਹ ਪੋਸ਼ ॥
1391.t: charaag(h) jahaa choo(n) shudheh burakeh posh ||

1391.g: ਸ਼ਹੇ ਸ਼ਬ ਬਰਾਮਦ ਹਮਹ ਜਲਵਹ ਜੋਸ਼ ॥੪੨॥
1391.t: shahe shab baraamadh hameh jalaveh josh ||42||
1391.e: When the lamp of the world veiled itself, the moon shone in brightness during the night.42.

1391.g: ਹਰ ਆਂ ਕਸ ਬ ਕਉਲੇ ਕੁਰਾ ਆਯਦਸ਼ ॥
1391.t: har aa(n) kas b kaule kuraa aayadhash ||

1391.g: ਕਿ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਬਰੋ ਰਹਿਨੁਮਾ ਆਯਦਸ਼ ॥੪੩॥
1391.t: k yazadhaa baro rahinumaa aayadhash ||43||
1391.e: He, who puts faith on the oaths of the Quran, the Ture Lord gives him the guidance.43.

1391.g: ਨ ਪੇਚੀਦਹ ਮੂਏ ਨ ਰੰਜੀਦਹ ਤਨ ॥
1391.t: n pecheedheh mooe na ra(n)jeedheh tan ||
1391.e: There was neither any harm nor injury

1391.g: ਕਿ ਬੇਰੂੰ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਆਵੁਰਦ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਸ਼ਿਕਨ ॥੪੪॥
1391.t: k beroo(n) khhudh aavuradh dhushaman shikan ||44||
1391.e: My Lord, the vanquisher of the enemies, brought me to safety.44.

1391.g: ਨ ਦਾਨਮ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਮਰਦਿ ਪੈਮਾ ਸ਼ਿਕਨ ॥
1391.t: n dhaanam k iee(n) maradh paimaa shikan ||

1391.g: ਕਿ ਦੌਲਤ ਪਰਸਤ ਓ ਈਮਾ ਫ਼ਿਕਨ ॥੪੫॥
1391.t: k dhaualat parasat o ieemaa phikan ||45||
1391.e: I did not know that these oath-breakers were deceitful and flowers of mammon.45.

1391.g: ਨ ਈਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਤੀ ਨ ਔਜ਼ਾਇ ਦੀਂ ॥
1391.t: n ieemaa prasatee na aauazai dhee(n) ||

1391.g: ਨ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸ਼ਨਾਸੀ ਨ ਮਹੰਮਦ ਯਕੀਂ ॥੪੬॥
1391.t: n saahib shanaasee na maha(n)madh yakee(n) ||46||
1391.e: They were neither men of faith, nor true followers of Islam, they did not know the Lord nor had faith in the prophet.46.

1391.g: ਹਰ ਆਂ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਈਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਤੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1391.t: har aa(n) kas k ieemaa prasatee kunadh ||

1391.g: ਨ ਪੈਮਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਸ਼ ਪੇਸ਼ੋ ਪਸਤੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੪੭॥
1391.t: n paimaa khhudhash pesho pasatee kunadh ||47||
1391.e: He, who follows his faith with sincerity, he never budges an inch from his oaths.47.

1391.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਮਰਦ ਰਾ ਜ਼ੱਰਹ ਏਤਬਾਰ ਨੇਸਤ ॥
1391.t: k iee(n) maradh raa za'reh etabaar nesat ||

1391.g: ਚਿ ਕਸਮੇ ਕੁਰਾਨਸਤੁ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਯਕੇਸਤ ॥੪੮॥
1391.t: ch kasame kuraanasat yazadhaa yakesat ||48||
1391.e: I have no faith at all in such a person for whom the oath of the Quran has no significance.48.

1391.g: ਚੁ ਕਸਮੇ ਕੁਰਾ ਸਦ ਕੁਨਦ ਇਖ਼ਤਿਯਾਰ ॥
1391.t: ch kasame kuraa sadh kunadh ikhhatiyaar ||

1391.g: ਮਰਾ ਕਤਰਹ ਨਾਯਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਏਤਬਾਰ ॥੪੯॥
1391.t: maraa katareh naayadh azo etabaar ||49||
1391.e: Even if you swear a hundred times in the name of the Quran, I shall not trust you any more.49.

1391.g: ਅਗਰਚਿ ਤੁਰਾ ਏਤਬਾਰ ਆਮਦੇ ॥
1391.t: agarach turaa etabaar aamadhe ||

1391.g: ਕਮਰ ਬਸਤ ਏ ਪੇਸ਼ਵਾ ਆਮਦੇ ॥੫੦॥
1391.t: kamar basat e peshavaa aamadhe ||50||
1391.e: If you have even a little of faith in God, come in the battlefield fully armed.50.

1391.g: ਕਿ ਫ਼ਰਜ਼ਸਤੁ ਬਰ ਸਰ ਤੁਰਾ ਈਂ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ॥
1391.t: k pharazasat bar sar turaa iee(n) sukhhan ||

1391.g: ਕਿ ਕਉਲੇ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਅਸਤੁ ਕਸਮਸਤੁ ਮਨ ॥੫੧॥
1391.t: k kaule khhudhaa asat kasamasat man ||51||
1391.e: It is your duty act on these words, because for me, these words are like the Orders of God.51.

1391.g: ਅਗਰ ਹਜ਼ਰਤੇ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਸਿਤਾਦਹ ਸ਼ਵਦ ॥
1391.t: agar hazarate khhudh sitaadheh shavadh ||

1391.g: ਬ ਜਾਨੋ ਦਿਲੇ ਕਾਰ ਵਾਜ਼ਿਹ ਸ਼ਵਦ ॥੫੨॥
1391.t: b jaano dhile kaar vaazeh shavadh ||52||
1391.e: If the Holy Prophet had been there himself, you would have acted on them with all your heart.52.

1391.g: ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ਰਾ ਫ਼ਰਜ਼ਸਤੁ ਕਾਰੇ ਕੁਨੀਂ ॥
1391.t: shumaa raa pharazasat kaare kunee(n) ||

1391.g: ਬਮੂਜਬ ਨਵਿਸ਼ਤਹ ਸ਼ੁਮਾਰੇ ਕੁਨੀਂ ॥੫੩॥
1391.t: bamoojab navishateh shumaare kunee(n) ||53||
1391.e: It is your duty and a binding on you to do as bidden in writing.53.

1391.g: ਨਵਿਸ਼ਤਹ ਰਸੀਦੋ ਬਗੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥
1391.t: navishateh raseedho baguphateh zubaa ||

1391.g: ਬਿਬਾਯਦ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਕਾਰ ਰਾਹਤ ਰਸਾ ॥੫੪॥
1391.t: bibaayadh k iee(n) kaar raahat rasaa ||54||
1391.e: I have received your letter and the message, do, whatever is required to be done.54.

1391.g: ਹਮੂੰ ਮਰਦ ਬਾਯਦ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨਵਰ ॥
1391.t: hamoo(n) maradh baayadh shavadh sukhhanavar ||
1391.e: One should act on his words

1392.g: ਨ ਸ਼ਿਕਮੇ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਦਰ ਦਹਾਨਿ ਦਿਗਰ ॥੫੫॥
1392.t: n shikame dhig(h)r dhar dhahaan dhigar ||55||
1392.e: The speech and action should correspond.55.

1392.g: ਕਿ ਕਾਜ਼ੀ ਮਰਾ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਬੇਰੂੰ ਨਯਮ ॥
1392.t: k kaazee maraa guphateh beroo(n) nayam ||

1392.g: ਅਗਰ ਰਾਸਤੀ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਬਿਯਾਰੀ ਕਦਮ ॥੫੬॥
1392.t: agar raasatee khhudh biyaaree kadham ||56||
1392.e: I agree with the words conveyed by the Qazi, but if you promise to come on the right path.56.

1392.g: ਤੁਰਾ ਗਰ ਬਬਾਯਦ ਬ ਕਉਲੇ ਕੁਰਾ ॥
1392.t: turaa gar babaayadh b kaule kuraa ||

1392.g: ਬਨਿਜ਼ਦੇ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ਰਾ ਰਸਾਨਮ ਹੁਮਾ ॥੫੭॥
1392.t: banizadhe shumaa raa rasaanam humaa ||57||
1392.e: If you want to see the letter containing oaths, I can send you the same immediatedly.57.

1392.g: ਕਿ ਤਸ਼ਰੀਫ ਦਰ ਕਸਬਹ ਕਾਗੜ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1392.t: k tashareef dhar kasabeh kaagaR kunadh ||

1392.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਪਸ ਮੁਲਾਕਾਤ ਬਾਹਮ ਸ਼ਵਦ ॥੫੮॥
1392.t: vazaa pas mulaakaat baaham shavadh ||58||
1392.e: If you come yourself in village Kangar, we can meet each other.58.

1392.g: ਨ ਜ਼ਰੱਹ ਦਰੀਂ ਰਾਹ ਖ਼ਤਰਹ ਤੁਰਾਸਤ ॥
1392.t: n zara'h dharee(n) raeh khhatareh turaasat ||
1392.e: Do not bring in your mind the danger of coming there

1392.g: ਹਮਹ ਕੌਮਿ ਬੈਰਾੜ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਰਾਸਤ ॥੫੯॥
1392.t: hameh kauam bairaaR hukam maraasat ||59||
1392.e: Because the Brar community acts according to my orders.59.

1392.g: ਬਿਯਾ ਤਾ ਬਮਨ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਨੀ ਕੁਨੇਮ ॥
1392.t: biyaa taa baman khhudh zubaanee kunem ||
1392.e: We can talk to each other in this way

1392.g: ਬਰੂਏ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ਮੇਹਰਬਾਨੀ ਕੁਨੇਮ ॥੬੦॥
1392.t: barooe shumaa meharabaanee kunem ||60||
1392.e: Kindly come so that we may have direct talk.60.

1392.g: ਯਕੇ ਅਸਪ ਸ਼ਾਇਸਤਏ ਯਕ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1392.t: yake asap shaisate yak hazaar ||
1392.e: Your saying that I may bring for you a very fine steed of one thousand rupees and

1392.g: ਬਿਯਾ ਤਾ ਬਗੀਰੀ ਬ ਮਨ ਈਂ ਦਿਯਾਰ ॥੬੧॥
1392.t: biyaa taa bageeree b man iee(n) dhiyaar ||61||
1392.e: Get this area as a feoff (jagir) from you, you may keep this thing in your mind.61.

1392.g: ਸ਼ਹਿਨਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਰਾ ਬੰਦਹੇ ਚਾਕਰੇਮ ॥
1392.t: shahinashaeh raa ba(n)dhahe chaakarem ||
1392.e: I am the man of the Sovereign of Sovereign and His slave

1392.g: ਅਗਰ ਹੁਕਮ ਆਯਦ ਬ ਜਾ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੇਮ ॥੬੨॥
1392.t: agar hukam aayadh b jaa haazarem ||62||
1392.e: If He permits me, then I shall present myself there.62.

1392.g: ਅਗਰਚੇ ਬਿਆਯਦ ਬ ਫ਼ੁਰਮਾਨ ਮਨ ॥
1392.t: agarache biaayadh b phuramaan man ||

1392.g: ਹਜ਼ੂਰ ਤ ਬਿਯਾਯਮ ਹਮਹ ਜਾਨ ਤਨ ॥੬੩॥
1392.t: hazoor ta biyaayam hameh jaan tan ||63||
1392.e: If He permits me, then I shall be present there in person.63.

1392.g: ਅਗਰ ਤੋ ਬਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਤੀ ਕੁਨੀ ॥
1392.t: agar to bayazadhaa prasatee kunee ||

1392.g: ਬ ਕਾਰੇ ਮਰਾ ਈਂ ਨ ਸੁਸਤੀ ਕੁਨੀ ॥੬੪॥
1392.t: b kaare maraa iee(n) na susatee kunee ||64||
1392.e: If you worship One Lord, you will not cause any delay in this work of mine.64.

1392.g: ਬਿਬਾਯਦ ਕਿ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਸ਼ਨਾਸੀ ਕੁਨੀ ॥
1392.t: bibaayadh k yazadhaa shanaasee kunee ||

1392.g: ਨ ਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਕਸੇ ਕਸ ਖ਼ਰਾਸ਼ੀ ਕੁਨੀ ॥੬੫॥
1392.t: n g(h)uphateh kase kas khharaashee kunee ||65||
1392.e: You should recognize the Lord, so that you may not talk ill or cause injury to anybody.65.

1392.g: ਤੁ ਮਸਨਦ ਨਸ਼ੀਂ ਸਰਵਰੇ ਕਾਇਨਾਤ ॥
1392.t: t masanadh nashee(n) saravare kainaat ||

1392.g: ਕਿ ਅਜਬ ਅਸਤੁ ਇਨਸਾਫ਼ ਈਂ ਹਮ ਸਫ਼ਾਤ ॥੬੬॥
1392.t: k ajab asat inasaaph iee(n) ham saphaat ||66||
1392.e: You are the Sovereign of the world and you sit on the throne, but I wonder at your ill acts of injustice.66.

1392.g: ਕਿ ਅਜਬ ਅਸਤੁ ਇਨਸਾਫ਼ੋ ਈਂ ਪਰਵਰੀ ॥
1392.t: k ajab asat inasaapho iee(n) paravaree ||
1392.e: I wonder at your acts of piety and justice

1393.g: ਕਿ ਹੈਫ਼ ਅਸਤੁ ਸਦ ਹੈਫ਼ ਈਂ ਸਰਵਰੀ ॥੬੭॥
1393.t: k haiph asat sadh haiph iee(n) saravaree ||67||
1393.e: I feel sorry at your sovereignty.67.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਅਜਬ ਅਸਤ ਅਜਬ ਅਸਤ ਤਕਵਾ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ॥
1393.t: k ajab asat ajab asat takavaa shumaa ||
1393.e: I wonder very much regarding your faith

1393.g: ਬਜੁਜ਼ ਰਾਸਤੀ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਨ ਜ਼ਯਾ ॥੬੮॥
1393.t: bajuz raasatee sukhhan guphatan zayaa ||68||
1393.e: Anything said against truth brings downfall.68.

1393.g: ਮਜ਼ਨ ਤੇਗ਼ ਬਰ ਖੂੰਨ ਕਸ ਬੇਦਰੇਗ਼ ॥
1393.t: mazan teg(h) bar khoo(n)n kas bedhareg(h) ||

1393.g: ਤੁਰਾ ਨੀਜ਼ ਖੂੰ ਅਸਤ ਬਾ ਚਰਖ਼ ਤੇਗ਼ ॥੬੯॥
1393.t: turaa neez khoo(n) asat baa charakhh teg(h) ||69||
1393.e: Do not be rash in striking your sword on helpless, otherwise the Providence will shed your blood.69.

1393.g: ਤੁ ਗਾਫ਼ਲ ਮਸੌ ਮਰਦ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਸ਼ਨਾਸ ॥
1393.t: t gaaphal masau maradh yazadhaa shanaas ||

1393.g: ਕਿ ਓ ਬੇਨਿਆਜ਼ ਅਸਤੁ ਓ ਬੇ ਸੁਪਾਸ ॥੭੦॥
1393.t: k o beniaaz asat o be supaas ||70||
1393.e: Do not be careless, recognize the Lord, who is averse to greed and flattery.70.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਊ ਬੇ ਮੁਹਾਬਸਤੁ ਸ਼ਾਹਾਨਿ ਸ਼ਾਹ ॥
1393.t: k uoo be muhaabasat shaahaan shaeh ||
1393.e: He, the Sovereign of Sovereigns, fears none

1393.g: ਜ਼ਿਮੀਨੋ ਜ਼ਮਾ ਸੱਚਏ ਪਾਤਿਸ਼ਾਹ ॥੭੧॥
1393.t: zimeeno zamaa sa'che paatishaeh ||71||
1393.e: He is the Master of the earth and heavens.71.

1393.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦਿ ਈਜ਼ਦ ਜ਼ਮੀਨੋ ਜ਼ਮਾ ॥
1393.t: khhudhaava(n)dh ieezadh zameeno zamaa ||
1393.e: He, the True Lord, is the Master of both the worlds

1393.g: ਕੁਨਿੰਦਹਸਤ ਹਰ ਕਸ ਮਕੀਨੋ ਮਕਾ ॥੭੨॥
1393.t: kuni(n)dhahasat har kas makeeno makaa ||72||
1393.e: He is the Creator of all the creatures of the universe.72.

1393.g: ਹਮ ਅਜ਼ ਪੀਰ ਮੋਰਹ ਹਮ ਅਜ਼ ਫ਼ੀਲ ਤਨ ॥
1393.t: ham az peer moreh ham az pheel tan ||
1393.e: He is the Presever of all, from ant to elephant

1393.g: ਕਿ ਆਜਜ਼ ਨਿਵਾਜ਼ ਅਸਤੋ ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਲ ਸ਼ਿਕੰਨ ॥੭੩॥
1393.t: k aajaz nivaaz asato g(h)aaphal shika(n)n ||73||
1393.e: He gives strength to the helpless and destroys the careless.73.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਊ ਰਾ ਚੁ ਇਸਮ ਅਸਤੁ ਆਜਜ਼ ਨਿਵਾਜ਼ ॥
1393.t: k uoo raa ch isam asat aajaz nivaaz ||
1393.e: The True Lord is known as ‘Protector of the lowly’

1393.g: ਕਿ ਊ ਬੇ ਸੁਪਾਸ ਅਸਤ ਊ ਬੇ ਨਿਯਾਜ਼ ॥੭੪॥
1393.t: k uoo be supaas asat uoo be niyaaz ||74||
1393.e: He is carefree and free from want.74.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਊ ਬੇ ਨਗੂੰ ਅਸਤੁ ਊ ਬੇ ਚਗੂੰ ॥
1393.t: k uoo be nagoo(n) asat uoo be chagoo(n) ||
1393.e: He is Unassailable and Unparalleled

1393.g: ਕਿ ਊ ਰਹਿਨੁਮਾ ਅਸਤੁ ਊ ਰਹਿਨਮੂੰ ॥੭੫॥
1393.t: k uoo rahinumaa asat uoo rahinamoo(n) ||75||
1393.e: He shows the path as a Guide.75.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਬਰ ਸਰ ਤੁਰਾ ਫ਼ਰਜ਼ ਕਸਮਿ ਕੁਰਾ ॥
1393.t: k bar sar turaa pharaz kasam kuraa ||

1393.g: ਬ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ਕਾਰ ਖ਼ੂਬੀ ਰਸਾ ॥੭੬॥
1393.t: b guphateh shumaa kaar khhoobee rasaa ||76||
1393.e: You are strained by the oath of the Quran, therefore, fulfil the promise made by you.76.

1393.g: ਬਿਬਾਯਦ ਤੁ ਦਾਨਸ਼ ਪ੍ਰਸਤੀ ਕੁਨੀ ॥
1393.t: bibaayadh ta dhaanash prasatee kunee ||

1393.g: ਬਕਾਰੇ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ਚੇਰਹ ਦਸਤੀ ਕੁਨੀ ॥੭੭॥
1393.t: bakaare shumaa chereh dhasatee kunee ||77||
1393.e: It is appropriate for you to become sane and do your task with severity.77.

1393.g: ਚਿਹਾ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਕਿ ਚੂੰ ਬੱਚਗਾ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਹ ਚਾਰ ॥
1393.t: chihaa shudh k choo(n) ba'chagaa kushateh chaar ||

1393.g: ਕਿ ਬਾਕੀ ਬਿਮਾਦਅਸਤੁ ਪੇਚੀਦਹ ਮਾਰ ॥੭੮॥
1393.t: k baakee bimaadhasat pecheedheh maar ||78||
1393.e: What, if you have killed my four sons, the hooded cobra still sits coiled up.78.

1393.g: ਚਿ ਮਰਦੀ ਕਿ ਅਖ਼ਗਰ ਖ਼ਮੋਸ਼ਾ ਕੁਨੀ ॥
1393.t: ch maradhee k akhhagar khhamoshaa kunee ||

1393.g: ਕਿ ਆਤਿਸ਼ ਦਮਾ ਰਾ ਫ਼ਰੋਜ਼ਾ ਕੁਨੀ ॥੭੯॥
1393.t: k aatish dhamaa raa pharozaa kunee ||79||
1393.e: What type of bravery it is to extinguish the speak of fire and fan the flames.79.

1393.g: ਚਿ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਗੁਫ਼ਤ ਫ਼ਿਰਦੌਸੀਏ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥
1393.t: ch khhush guphat phiradhauase'ee khhush zubaa ||

1393.g: ਸ਼ਿਤਾਬੀ ਬਵਦ ਕਾਰਿ ਆਹਰਮਨਾ ॥੮੦॥
1393.t: shitaabee bavadh kaar aaharamanaa ||80||
1393.e: Listen to this well-said quotation of Firdausi : “The hasty action is the work of Satan”.80.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਮਾ ਬਾਰਗਹਿ ਹਜ਼ਰਤ ਆਯਦ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ॥
1393.t: k maa baarageh hazarat aayadh shumaa ||

1393.g: ਅਜ਼ਾ ਰੋਜ਼ ਬਾਸ਼ੇਦ ਸ਼ਾਹਿਦ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ॥੮੧॥
1393.t: azaa roz baashedh shaahidh shumaa ||81||
1393.e: I have also come from the abode of Your Lord, who will be the witness on the day of Judgement.81.

1393.g: ਵਗਰਨਹ ਤੁ ਈਂ ਰਾ ਫ਼ਰਾਮੋਸ਼ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1393.t: vagaraneh ta iee(n) raa pharaamosh kunadh ||

1393.g: ਤੁਰਾ ਹਮ ਫ਼ਰਾਮੋਸ਼ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੮੨॥
1393.t: turaa ham pharaamosh yazadhaa kunadh ||82||
1393.e: If you prepare yourself for the good action, the Lord will give you an apt reward.82.

1393.g: ਅਗਰ ਕਾਰਿ ਈਂ ਬਰ ਤੂ ਬਸਤੀ ਕਮਰ ॥
1393.t: agar kaar iee(n) bar too basatee kamar ||

1393.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਤੁਰਾ ਬਹਰਹ ਵਰ ॥੮੩॥
1393.t: khhudhaava(n)dh baashadh turaa bahareh var ||83||
1393.e: If you forget this task of Justice, the Lord will forget you.83.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਕਾਰ ਨੇਕਅਸਤੁ ਦੀਂ ਪਰਵਰੀ ॥
1393.t: k iee(n) kaar nekasat dhee(n) paravaree ||

1393.g: ਚੁ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਸ਼ਨਾਸੀ ਬਜਾ ਬਰਤਰੀ ॥੮੪॥
1393.t: ch yazadhaa shanaasee bajaa barataree ||84||
1393.e: The righteous has to tread the path of truth and virtue, but it is still better to recognize the Lord.84.

1393.g: ਤੁਰਾ ਮਨ ਨ ਦਾਨਮ ਕਿ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਸ਼ਨਾਸ ॥
1393.t: turaa man na dhaanam k yazadhaa shanaas ||

1393.g: ਬਰਾਮਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਤੂ ਕਾਰਹਾ ਦਿਲ ਖ਼ਰਾਸ ॥੮੫॥
1393.t: baraamadh z too kaarahaa dhil khharaas ||85||
1393.e: I do not believe that man recognizes the Lord, who injures the sentiments of others through his action.85.

1393.g: ਸ਼ਨਾਸਦ ਹਮੀਂ ਤੂ ਨ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਕਰੀਮ ॥
1393.t: shanaasadh hamee(n) too na yazadhaa kareem ||

1393.g: ਨ ਖ਼੍ਵਾਹਦ ਹਮੀ ਤੂ ਬਦੌਲਤ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥੮੬॥
1393.t: n khhavaiaahadh hamee too badhaualat azeem ||86||
1393.e: The True and Merciful Lord does not love you, though you have unaccountable wealth.86.

1393.g: ਅਗਰ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਾ ਰਾ ਬਖ਼ੁਰਦੀ ਕਸਮ ॥
1393.t: agar sadh kuraa raa bakhhuradhee kasam ||

1393.g: ਮਰਾ ਏਤਬਾਰੇ ਨ ਈਂ ਜ਼ਰਹ ਦਮ ॥੮੭॥
1393.t: maraa etabaare na iee(n) zareh dham ||87||
1393.e: Even if you swear a hundred times by the Quran, I shall never trust you.87.

1393.g: ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਨ ਆਯਮ ਨ ਈਂ ਰਹ ਸ਼ਵਮ ॥
1393.t: hazooree na aayam na iee(n) reh shavam ||
1393.e: I cannot come to you and am not prepared to tread your path of oaths

1393.g: ਅਗਰ ਸ਼ਹ ਬਖ਼੍ਵਾਹਦ ਮਨ ਆਂ ਜਾ ਰਵਮ ॥੮੮॥
1393.t: agar sheh bakhhavaiaahadh man aa(n) jaa ravam ||88||
1393.e: I shall go, wherever my Lord will ask me to go.88.

1393.g: ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਸ਼ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਸ਼ਾਹਾਨ ਔਰੰਗਜ਼ੇਬ ॥
1393.t: khhushash shaeh shaahaan aauara(n)gazeb ||
1393.e: You are king of king, O fortunate Aurangzeb

1393.g: ਕਿ ਚਾਲਾਕ ਦਸਤੁ ਅਸਤੁ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਰਕੇਬ ॥੮੯॥
1393.t: k chaalaak dhasat asat chaabuk rakeb ||89||
1393.e: You are a clever administrator and a good horseman.89.

1393.g: ਚਿ ਹੁਸਨਲ ਜਮਾਲਸਤੁ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਜ਼ਮੀਰ ॥
1393.t: ch husanal jamaalasat rauashan zameer ||

1393.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦ ਮੁਲਕ ਅਸਤੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਅਮੀਰ ॥੯੦॥
1393.t: khhudhaava(n)dh mulak asat saahib ameer ||90||
1393.e: With the help of your intelligence and the sword, you have become the master of Deg and Tegh.90.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਤਰਤੀਬ ਦਾਨਸ਼ ਬ ਤਦਬੀਰ ਤੇਗ਼ ॥
1393.t: k tarateeb dhaanash b tadhabeer teg(h) ||
1393.e: You are the acme of beauty and wisdom

1393.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦਿ ਦੇਗ਼ੋ ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦਿ ਤੇਗ਼ ॥੯੧॥
1393.t: khhudhaava(n)dh dheg(h)o khhudhaava(n)dh teg(h) ||91||
1393.e: You are the chief of chiefs and the king.91.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਜ਼ਮੀਰ ਅਸਤੁ ਹੁਸਨੁਲ ਜਮਾਲ ॥
1393.t: k rauashan zameer asat husanul jamaal ||
1393.e: You are the acme of beauty and wisdom

1393.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿੰਦਹੇ ਮੁਲਕੋ ਮਾਲ ॥੯੨॥
1393.t: khhudhaava(n)dh bakhhashi(n)dhahe mulako maal ||92||
1393.e: You are the master of the country and its wealth.92.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਸਤੁ ਦਰ ਜੰਗ ਕੋਹ ॥
1393.t: k bakhhashish kabeer asat dhar ja(n)g koh ||
1393.e: You are most generous and a mountain in the battlefield

1393.g: ਮਲਾਯਕ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਚੂੰ ਸੁਰੱਯਾ ਸ਼ਿਕੋਹ ॥੯੩॥
1393.t: malaayak siphat choo(n) sura'yaa shikoh ||93||
1393.e: You are like angels wielding high splendour.93.

1393.g: ਸ਼ਹਿਨਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਔਰੰਗਜ਼ੇਬ ਆਲਮੀਂ ॥
1393.t: shahinashaeh aauara(n)gazeb aalamee(n) ||

1393.g: ਕਿ ਦਾਰਾਇ ਦੌਰ ਅਸਤੁ ਦੂਰ ਅਸਤ ਦੀਂ ॥੯੪॥
1393.t: k dhaarai dhauar asat dhoor asat dhee(n) ||94||
1393.e: Though you are the king of kings, O Aurangzeb! you are far from righteousness and justice.94.

1393.g: ਮਨਮ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਹਅਮ ਕੋਹੀਆ ਬੁਤਪ੍ਰਸਤ ॥
1393.t: manam kushataham koheeaa butaprasat ||

1393.g: ਕਿ ਆਂ ਬੁਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਤੰਦੋ ਮਨ ਬੁਤ ਸ਼ਿਕਸਤ ॥੯੫॥
1393.t: k aa(n) but prasata(n)dho man but shikasat ||95||
1393.e: I vanquished the vicious hill chiefs, they were idol-worshippers and I am idol-breaker.95.

1393.g: ਬਬੀਂ ਗ਼ਰਦਸ਼ੇ ਬੇਵਫ਼ਾਏ ਜ਼ਮਾ ॥
1393.t: babee(n) g(h)radhashe bevaphaae zamaa ||

1393.g: ਪਸੇ ਪੁਸ਼ਤ ਉਫ਼ਤਦ ਰਸਾਨਦ ਜ਼ਿਯਾ ॥੯੬॥
1393.t: pase pushat uphatadh rasaanadh ziyaa ||96||
1393.e: Look at the time-cycle, quite undependable whosoever it pursues, it brings his decline.96.

1393.g: ਬਬੀਂ ਕੁਦਰਤੇ ਨੇਕ ਯਜ਼ਦਾਨਿ ਪਾਕ ॥
1393.t: babee(n) kudharate nek yazadhaan paak ||

1393.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਯਕ ਬ ਦਹ ਲਖ਼ ਰਸਾਨਦ ਹਲਾਕ ॥੯੭॥
1393.t: k az yak b dheh lakhh rasaanadh halaak ||97||
1393.e: Think of the power of the Holy Lord, which causes one persons to kill lakhs of people.97.

1393.g: ਕਿ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਕੁਨਦ ਮਿਹਰਬਾ ਅਸਤੁ ਦੋਸਤ ॥
1393.t: k dhushaman kunadh miharabaa asat dhosat ||
1393.e: If God is friendly, no enemy can do anything

1393.g: ਕਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਕਾਰ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿੰਦਹ ਓਸਤ ॥੯੮॥
1393.t: k bakhhashi(n)dhagee kaar bakhhashi(n)dheh osat ||98||
1393.e: The generous action proceed from the merciful Lord.98.

1393.g: ਰਿਹਾਈ ਦਿਹੋ ਰਹਿਨੁਮਾਈ ਦਿਹਦ ॥
1393.t: rihaiee dhiho rahinumaiee dhihadh ||

1393.g: ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਰਾ ਬਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਆਸ਼ਨਾਈ ਦਿਹਦ ॥੯੯॥
1393.t: zubaa raa basiphat aashanaiee dhihadh ||99||
1393.e: He is the Emancipator and the Guide, who causes our tongue to sing His Praises.99.

1393.g: ਖ਼ਸਮ ਰਾ ਚੁ ਕੋਰਊ ਕੁਨਦ ਵਕਤਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
1393.t: khhasam raa ch koruoo kunadh vakat kaar ||
1393.e: In throubled times He withdraws the faculty of sight from the enemies

1393.g: ਯਤੀਮਾ ਬਿਰੂੰ ਮੇ ਬੁਰਦ ਬੇਅਜ਼ਾਰ ॥੧੦੦॥
1393.t: yateemaa biroo(n) me buradh beazaar ||100||
1393.e: He releases without injury the suppressed and the lowly.100.

1393.g: ਹਰਾ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਓ ਰਾਸਤ ਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1393.t: haraa kas k o raasat baazee kunadh ||

1393.g: ਰਹੀਮੇ ਬਰੋ ਰਹਮ ਸਾਜ਼ੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੧੦੧॥
1393.t: raheeme baro raham saazee kunadh ||101||
1393.e: He, who is tuuthful and follows the right path, the Merciful Lord is Graceful towards him.101.

1393.g: ਕਸੇ ਖ਼ਿਦਮਤ ਆਯਦ ਬਸੇ ਦਿਲੋ ਜਾ ॥
1393.t: kase khhidhamat aayadh base dhilo jaa ||

1393.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਬਰ ਵੈ ਅਮਾ ॥੧੦੨॥
1393.t: khhudhaava(n)dh bakhhasheedh bar vai amaa ||102||
1393.e: He, who surrenders his mind and body to Him, the True Lord is Graceful towards him.102.

1393.g: ਚਿ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਬਰਾ ਹੀਲਹ ਸਾਜ਼ੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1393.t: ch dhushaman baraa heeleh saazee kunadh ||

1394.g: ਅਗਰ ਰਹਨੁਮਾ ਬਰ ਵੈ ਰਾਜ਼ੀ ਸ਼ਵਦ ॥੧੦੩॥
1394.t: agar rahanumaa bar vai raazee shavadh ||103||
1394.e: No enemy can ever beguile him, on whom the Merciful Lord showers His Graces.103.

1394.g: ਅਗਰ ਯਕ ਬਰ ਆਯਦ ਦਹੋ ਦਹ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1394.t: agar yak bar aayadh dhaho dheh hazaar ||

1394.g: ਨਿਗਹਬਾਨ ਊ ਰਾ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਕਿਰਦਗਾਰ ॥੧੦੪॥
1394.t: nigahabaan uoo raa shavadh kiradhagaar ||104||
1394.e: When one man is attacked by lakh, the Generous Lord gives him protection.104.

1394.g: ਤੁਰਾ ਗਰ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਹਸਤ ਲਸ਼ਕਰ ਵ ਜ਼ਰ ॥
1394.t: turaa gar nazar hasat lashakar v zar ||

1394.g: ਕਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਨਿਗਹ ਅਸਤੁ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਸ਼ੁਕਰ ॥੧੦੫॥
1394.t: k maaraa nigeh asat yazadhaa shukar ||105||
1394.e: Just as your hopes lie in your wealth, I depend upon the Grace of the Lord.105.

1394.g: ਕਿ ਊ ਰਾ ਗ਼ਰੂਰ ਅਸਤ ਬਰ ਮੁਲਕੁ ਮਾਲ ॥
1394.t: k uoo raa g(h)roor asat bar mulak maal ||

1394.g: ਵ ਮਾਰਾ ਪਨਾਹ ਅਸਤੁ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਅਕਾਲ ॥੧੦੬॥
1394.t: v maaraa panaeh asat yazadhaa akaal ||106||
1394.e: You are proud of your kingdom and wealth, but I take refuge in the Non-Temporal Lord.106.

1394.g: ਤੁ ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਲ ਮਸ਼ੌ ਜ਼ੀ ਸਿਪੰਜੀ ਸਰਾਇ ॥
1394.t: t g(h)aaphal mashau zee sipa(n)jee sarai ||

1394.g: ਕਿ ਆਲਮ ਬਗੁਜ਼ਰਦ ਸਰੇ ਜਾ ਬਜਾਇ ॥੧੦੭॥
1394.t: k aalam baguzaradh sare jaa bajai ||107||
1394.e: Do not be careless about this fact that this saraae (resting place) is not the permanent abode.107.

1394.g: ਬਬੀਂ ਗਰਦਸ਼ਿ ਬੇਵਫ਼ਾਏ ਜ਼ਮਾ ॥
1394.t: babee(n) garadhash bevaphaae zamaa ||
1394.e: Look at the time-cycle, which is undependable

1394.g: ਕਿ ਬਰ ਹਰ ਬੁਗ਼ੁਜ਼ਰਦ ਮਕੀਨੋ ਮਕਾ ॥੧੦੮॥
1394.t: k bar har bug(h)uzaradh makeeno makaa ||108||
1394.e: It gives a fatal blow to everything of this world.108.

1394.g: ਤੁ ਗਰ ਜ਼ਬਰ ਆਜਜ਼ ਖ਼ਰਾਸ਼ੀ ਮਕੁਨ ॥
1394.t: t gar zabar aajaz khharaashee makun ||
1394.e: Do not oppose the lowly and helpless

1394.g: ਕਸਮ ਰਾ ਬ ਤੇਸ਼ਹ ਤਰਾਸ਼ੀ ਮਕੁਨ ॥੧੦੯॥
1394.t: kasam raa b tesheh taraashee makun ||109||
1394.e: Do not break the oaths taken on the Quran.109.

1394.g: ਚੁ ਹਕ ਯਾਰ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਚਿ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1394.t: ch hak yaar baashadh ch dhushaman kunadh ||

1394.g: ਅਗਰ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨੀ ਰਾ ਬ ਸਦ ਤਨ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੧੧੦॥
1394.t: agar dhushamanee raa b sadh tan kunadh ||110||
1394.e: If God is friendly, what the enemy can do?, though he may be inimical in many ways.110.

1394.g: ਖ਼ਸਮ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨੀ ਗਰ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਆਵੁਰਦ ॥
1394.t: khhasam dhushamanee gar hazaar aavuradh ||

1394.g: ਨ ਯਕ ਮੂਇ ਊ ਰਾ ਅਜ਼ਾਰ ਆਵੁਰਦ ॥੧੧੧॥੧॥
1394.t: n yak mooi uoo raa azaar aavuradh ||111||1||
1394.e: The enemy may try to give a thousand blows, but he cannot harm even one hair, (if God is friendly).111.

1394.g: ਹਿਕਾਇਤਾ ॥
1394.t: hikaitaa ||
1394.e: Hikayats

1394.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫ਼ਤਹ ॥
1394.t: ikOankaar vaahaguroo jee kee phateh ||
1394.e: Glory to God

1394.g: ਅਗੰਜੋ ਅਭੰਜੋ ਅਰੂਪੋ ਅਰੇਖ ॥
1394.t: aga(n)jo abha(n)jo aroopo arekh ||
1394.e: Now listen to the Tale of Raja Daleep,

1394.g: ਅਗਾਧੋ ਅਬਾਧੋ ਅਭਰਮੋ ਅਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
1394.t: agaadho abaadho abharamo alekh ||1||
1394.e: Who was sitting besides the Honourable One (the King).(1)

1394.g: ਅਰਾਗੋ ਅਰੂਪੋ ਅਰੇਖੋ ਅਰੰਗ ॥
1394.t: araago aroopo arekho ara(n)g ||
1394.e: The King had four sons,

1394.g: ਅਜਨਮੋ ਅਬਰਨੋ ਅਭੂਤੋ ਅਭੰਗ ॥੨॥
1394.t: ajanamo abarano abhooto abha(n)g ||2||
1394.e: Who had learned the art of fighting and the Royal Court Etiquettes.(2)

1394.g: ਅਛੇਦੋ ਅਭੇਦੋ ਅਕਰਮੋ ਅਕਾਮ ॥
1394.t: achhedho abhedho akaramo akaam ||
1394.e: In the war they were like the crocodiles and excited lions,

1394.g: ਅਖੇਦੋ ਅਭੇਦੋ ਅਭਰਮੋ ਅਭਾਮ ॥੩॥
1394.t: akhedho abhedho abharamo abhaam ||3||
1394.e: Also they were very proficient horse-riders and adept in the hand-movements.(3)

1394.g: ਅਰੇਖੋ ਅਭੇਖੋ ਅਲੇਖੋ ਅਭੰਗ ॥
1394.t: arekho abhekho alekho abha(n)g ||
1394.e: The King called all his four sons,

1394.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿੰਦਹੇ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ॥੪॥
1394.t: khhudhaava(n)dh bakhhashi(n)dhahe ra(n)g ra(n)g ||4||
1394.e: And offered them to sit on the gilded chairs.(4)

1394.g: ਹਿਕਾਯਤ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦੇਮ ਰਾਜਹਿ ਦਿਲੀਪ ॥
1394.t: hikaayat shuneedhem raajeh dhileep ||
1394.e: He, then, asked his prolific ministers,

1394.g: ਨਿਸ਼ਸਤਹ ਬੁਦਹ ਨਿਜ਼ਦ ਮਾਨੋ ਮਹੀਪ ॥੫॥
1394.t: nishasateh budheh nizadh maano maheep ||5||
1394.e: ‘Who among these four is suitable for kingship?‘(5)

1394.g: ਕਿ ਓਰਾ ਹਮੀ ਬੂਦ ਪਿਸਰੇ ਚਹਾਰ ॥
1394.t: k oraa hamee boodh pisare chahaar ||
1394.e: When the wise minister heard this,

1394.g: ਕਿ ਦਰ ਰਜ਼ਮ ਦਰ ਬਜ਼ਮ ਆਮੁਖ਼ਤਹ ਕਾਰ ॥੬॥
1394.t: k dhar razam dhar bazam aamukhhateh kaar ||6||
1394.e: He raised the flag to answer.(6)

1394.g: ਬ ਰਜ਼ਮ ਅੰਦਰਾ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਅਜ਼ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਮਸਤ ॥
1394.t: b razam a(n)dharaa ham ch az sher masat ||
1394.e: He spoke thus, ‘you are, yourself righteous and wise,

1394.g: ਕਿ ਚਾਬਕ ਰਿਕਾਬਸਤੁ ਗੁਸਤਾਖ਼ ਦਸਤ ॥੭॥
1394.t: k chaabak rikaabasat gusataakhh dhasat ||7||
1394.e: ‘You are perceiver and possessor of independent reflections.(7)

1394.g: ਚਹਾਰੋ ਸ਼ਹੇ ਪੇਸ਼ ਪਿਸਰਾ ਬੁਖਾਦ ॥
1394.t: chahaaro shahe pesh pisaraa bukhaadh ||
1394.e: ‘This, what you have asked, is beyond my faculty.

1394.g: ਜੁਦਾ ਬਰ ਜੁਦਾ ਕੁਰਸੀਏ ਜ਼ਰ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੮॥
1394.t: judhaa bar judhaa kurase'ee zar nishaadh ||8||
1394.e: ‘Me suggesting might cause some friction.(8)

1394.g: ਬਿ ਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਦਾਨਾਇ ਦਉਲਤ ਪਰਸਤ ॥
1394.t: b purasheedh dhaanai dhaulat parasat ||
1394.e: ‘But, My Sovereign, if you insist, I would say,

1394.g: ਅਜ਼ੀ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਕਸ ਅਸਤ ॥੯॥
1394.t: azee a(n)dharoo(n) baadhashaahee kas asat ||9||
1394.e: ‘And present you the reaction (of our council).(9)

1394.g: ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦ ਆਂ ਚੁ ਦਾਨਾਇ ਦਾਨਸ਼ ਨਿਹਾਦ ॥
1394.t: shuneedh aa(n) ch dhaanai dhaanash nihaadh ||
1394.e: ‘Because the one who endows helping hand,

1394.g: ਬ ਤਮਕੀਨ ਪਾਸਖ ਅਲਮ ਬਰ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੧੦॥
1394.t: b tamakeen paasakh alam bar kushaadh ||10||
1394.e: ‘Gets the (godly) help to gain success.(10)

1394.g: ਬ ਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤੰਦ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਦੀਨ ਦਾਨਾਇ ਨਗ਼ਜ਼ ॥
1394.t: b g(h)uphata(n)dh khhush dheen dhaanai nag(h)z ||
1394.e: ‘First of all we must test their intelligence,

1394.g: ਕਿ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਸ਼ਨਾਸ ਅਸਤੁ ਆਜ਼ਾਦ ਮਗ਼ਜ਼ ॥੧੧॥
1394.t: k yazadhaa shanaas asat aazaadh mag(h)z ||11||
1394.e: ‘And then we will set them on trial to judge their work.(11)

1394.g: ਮਰਾ ਕੁਦਰਤੇ ਨੇਸਤ ਈਂ ਗੁਫ਼ਤ ਨੀਸਤ ॥
1394.t: maraa kudharate nesat iee(n) guphat neesat ||
1394.e: ‘One (boy) should be given ten thousand elephants,

1394.g: ਸੁਖਨ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਨੋ ਬਿਕਰ ਜਾ ਸੁਫ਼ਤ ਨੀਸਤ ॥੧੨॥
1394.t: sukhan guphatano bikar jaa suphat neesat ||12||
1394.e: ‘And those (elephants) must be intoxicated and tied in heavy chains.(12)

1394.g: ਅਗਰ ਸ਼ਹਿ ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਬਿਗੋਯਮ ਜਵਾਬ ॥
1394.t: agar sheh bigoyadh bigoyam javaab ||
1394.e: ‘To the second one, we will give one hundred thousand horses,

1394.g: ਨੁਮਾਯਮ ਬ ਤੋ ਹਾਲ ਈਂ ਬਾ ਸਵਾਬ ॥੧੩॥
1394.t: numaayam b to haal iee(n) baa savaab ||13||
1394.e: ‘On whose backs there will be gilded saddles, as charming as the spring-season.(13)

1394.g: ਹਰਾ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਯਜ਼ਦਾਨ ਯਾਰੀ ਦਿਹਦ ॥
1394.t: haraa kas k yazadhaan yaaree dhihadh ||
1394.e: ‘The third one will be given three hundred thousand camels,

1394.g: ਬ ਕਾਰੇ ਜਹਾ ਕਾਮਗਾਰੀ ਦਿਹਦ ॥੧੪॥
1394.t: b kaare jahaa kaamagaaree dhihadh ||14||
1394.e: ‘Whose backs will be adorned with silver trappings.(14)

1394.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਰਾ ਬ ਅਕਲ ਆਜ਼ਮਾਈ ਕੁਨੇਮ ॥
1394.t: k iee(n) raa b akal aazamaiee kunem ||
1394.e: ‘To the fourth one, we will give one seed of moong (lentil) and half a seed of gram,

1395.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਪਸ ਬ ਕਾਰ ਆਜ਼ਮਾਈ ਕੁਨੇਮ ॥੧੫॥
1395.t: vazaa pas b kaar aazamaiee kunem ||15||
1395.e: ‘Because that one possesses independent convictions and is endowed with intelligence.‘(15)

1395.g: ਯਕੇ ਰਾ ਦਿਹਦ ਫ਼ੀਲ ਦਹਿ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਮਸਤ ॥
1395.t: yake raa dhihadh pheel dheh hazaar masat ||
1395.e: The one (the prince), who was wise, brought them (the seeds) to his home,

1395.g: ਹਮਹ ਮਸਤੀਓ ਮਸਤ ਜ਼ੰਜੀਰ ਬਸਤ ॥੧੬॥
1395.t: hameh masateeo masat za(n)jeer basat ||16||
1395.e: And also acquired one more whole seed of gram.(16)

1395.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਰਾ ਦਿਹਦ ਅਸਪ ਪਾ ਸਦ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1395.t: dhig(h)r raa dhihadh asap paa sadh hazaar ||
1395.e: It was conceived that he would sow the seed,

1395.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਜ਼ਰ ਸਾਖ਼ਤਹ ਜ਼ੀਨ ਚੂੰ ਨਉ ਬਹਾਰ ॥੧੭॥
1395.t: z zar saakhhateh zeen choo(n) nau bahaar ||17||
1395.e: And through that his intelligence could be adjudged.(17)

1395.g: ਸਿਯਮ ਰਾ ਦਿਹਦ ਸ਼ੁਤਰ ਸਿ ਸਦ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1395.t: siyam raa dhihadh shutar s sadh hazaar ||
1395.e: He sowed both the seeds in the soil,

1395.g: ਹਮਹ ਨੁਕਰਹ ਬਾਰੋ ਹਮਹ ਜ਼ਰ ਨਿਗਾਰ ॥੧੮॥
1395.t: hameh nukareh baaro hameh zar nigaar ||18||
1395.e: And sought the blessedness of Almighty.(18)

1395.g: ਚੁਅਮ ਰਾ ਦਿਹਦ ਮੁੰਗ ਯਕ ਨੁਖ਼ਦ ਨੀਮ ॥
1395.t: chuam raa dhihadh mu(n)g yak nukhhadh neem ||
1395.e: A period of six months had passed, when,

1395.g: ਅਜ਼ਾ ਮਰਦ ਆਜ਼ਾਦ ਆਕਲ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥੧੯॥
1395.t: azaa maradh aazaadh aakal azeem ||19||
1395.e: With the dawn of new season, the greenery sprouted.(19)

1395.g: ਬਿਯਾਵੁਰਦ ਪੁਰ ਅਕਲ ਖ਼ਾਨਹ ਕਜ਼ਾ ॥
1395.t: biyaavuradh pur akal khhaaneh kazaa ||
1395.e: He kept repeating the process for ten years,

1395.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਨੀਮ ਨੁਖ਼ਦਸ਼ ਬ ਬਸਤਨ ਅਜ਼ਾ ॥੨੦॥
1395.t: dhig(h)r neem nukhhadhash b basatan azaa ||20||
1395.e: And increased the produce by looking after them skilfully.(20)

1395.g: ਹਮੀ ਖ਼ਾਸ਼ਤ ਕੋ ਤੁਖ਼ਮ ਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1395.t: hamee khhaashat ko tukhham rezee kunadh ||
1395.e: By repeating the seeding for ten, twenty times,

1395.g: ਖ਼ਿਰਦ ਆਜ਼ਮਾਯਸ਼ ਬਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੨੧॥
1395.t: khhiradh aazamaayash barezee kunadh ||21||
1395.e: He accumulated great many heaps of grains.(21)

1395.g: ਦਫ਼ਨ ਕਰਦ ਹਰਦੋ ਜ਼ਮੀਂ ਅੰਦਰਾ ॥
1395.t: dhaphan karadh haradho zamee(n) a(n)dharaa ||
1395.e: Doing so he amassed a good amount of wealth,

1395.g: ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕਰਦ ਬਰ ਸ਼ੁਕਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗਿਰਾ ॥੨੨॥
1395.t: nazar karadh bar shukar saahib giraa ||22||
1395.e: Which had come through those mounds of cereals.(22)

1395.g: ਚੁ ਸ਼ਸ਼ ਮਾਹਿ ਗੁਸ਼ਤੰਦ ਦਰਾ ਦਫ਼ਨਵਾਰ ॥
1395.t: ch shash maeh gushata(n)dh dharaa dhaphanavaar ||
1395.e: Using this (money) he purchased ten thousand elephants,

1395.g: ਪਦੀਦ ਆਮਦਹ ਸਬਜ਼ਹੇ ਨਉ ਬਹਾਰ ॥੨੩॥
1395.t: padheedh aamadheh sabazahe nau bahaar ||23||
1395.e: Which were as tall as mountains and they walked like the water of river Nile.(23)

1395.g: ਬਰੇਜ਼ੀਦ ਦਹਿ ਸਾਲ ਤੁਖ਼ਮੇ ਕਜ਼ਾ ॥
1395.t: barezeedh dheh saal tukhhame kazaa ||
1395.e: Also he bought five thousand horses,

1395.g: ਬ ਪਰਵਰਦਹ ਓਰਾ ਬੁਰੀਦਨ ਅਜ਼ਾ ॥੨੪॥
1395.t: b paravaradheh oraa bureedhan azaa ||24||
1395.e: Who had gilded saddles and silver trappings.(24)

1395.g: ਬਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦਹੇ ਬੀਸਤ ਬਾਰਸ਼ ਅਜ਼ੋ ॥
1395.t: barezee dhahe beesat baarash azo ||
1395.e: Three thousand camels, which he had acquired,

1395.g: ਬਸੇ ਗਸ਼ਤਹ ਖ਼ਰਵਾਰ ਦਾਨਹ ਅਜ਼ੋ ॥੨੫॥
1395.t: base gashateh khharavaar dhaaneh azo ||25||
1395.e: All of them had bags full of gold and silver at their backs.(25)

1395.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਜ਼ਿਯਾਦਹ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਦਉਲਤੇ ਦਿਲ ਕਰਾਰ ॥
1395.t: chunaa ziyaadheh shudh dhaulate dhil karaar ||
1395.e: With the monetary strength coming through one seed,

1395.g: ਕਜ਼ੋ ਦਾਨਹ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਦਾਨਹਾਏ ਅੰਬਾਰ ॥੨੬॥
1395.t: kazo dhaaneh shudh dhaanahaae a(n)baar ||26||
1395.e: He inhabited a new city called Delhi.(26)

1395.g: ਖ਼ਰੀਦਹ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਨਕਦ ਦਹਿ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਫ਼ੀਲ ॥
1395.t: khhareedheh azaa nakadh dheh hazaar pheel ||
1395.e: And the money coming through the moong seed he flourished the City of Moong,

1396.g: ਚੁ ਕੋਹੇ ਰਵਾ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਦਰੀਆਇ ਨੀਲ ॥੨੭॥
1396.t: ch kohe ravaa ham ch dhareeaai neel ||27||
1396.e: Which was extremely admired by his confidants.(27)

1396.g: ਬਗੀਰਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਅਸਪ ਪਾਸਦ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1396.t: bageeradh azo asap paasadh hazaar ||
1396.e: Proceeding as such, a period of twelve years had lapsed.

1396.g: ਹਮਹ ਜਰ ਵ ਜ਼ੀਨੋ ਹਮਹ ਨੁਕਰਹਵਾਰ ॥੨੮॥
1396.t: hameh jar v zeeno hameh nukarahavaar ||28||
1396.e: And undiminishable amount of wealth was amassed.(28)

1396.g: ਖ਼ਰੀਦੰਦ ਸੇ ਸਦ ਹਜ਼ਾਰੋ ਸ਼ੁਤਰ ॥
1396.t: khhareedha(n)dh se sadh hazaaro shutar ||
1396.e: The King was seated on the throne majestically.

1396.g: ਹਮਹ ਜ਼ਰਹ ਬਾਰੋ ਹਮਹ ਨੁਕਰਹ ਪੁਰ ॥੨੯॥
1396.t: hameh zareh baaro hameh nukareh pur ||29||
1396.e: When he (the Minister) walked in and the King of seven continents asked,(29)

1396.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਦਾਲ ਨਉ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਆਜ਼ਮ ਬੁਬਸਤ ॥
1396.t: vazaa dhaal nau shahir aazam bubasat ||
1396.e: ‘Bring and present to me the papers,

1396.g: ਕਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਦਿਹਲੀ ਸ਼ੁਦਸਤ ॥੩੦॥
1396.t: k naame azaa shahir dhihalee shudhasat ||30||
1396.e: ‘Which enumerate what I had endowed to my four sons.‘(30)

1396.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਦਾਨਹ ਰਾ ਬਸਤ ਮੂੰਗੀ ਪਟਨ ॥
1396.t: dhig(h)r dhaaneh raa basat moo(n)gee paTan ||
1396.e: The recording scribe picked up the pen,

1396.g: ਚੁ ਦੋਸਤਾ ਪਸੰਦਸਤੁ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਫ਼ਿਕਨ ॥੩੧॥
1396.t: ch dhosataa pasa(n)dhasat dhushaman phikan ||31||
1396.e: And to reply, (he) raised his flag.(31)

1396.g: ਬ ਗੁਜ਼ਰੀਦ ਦਹ ਦੋ ਬਰ ਈਂ ਨਮਤ ਸਾਲ ॥
1396.t: b guzareedh dheh dho bar iee(n) namat saal ||
1396.e: (The Raja asked,) ‘I had bequeathed them thousands (of rupees),

1396.g: ਬਸੇ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਜੋ ਦਉਲਤੇ ਬੇ ਜ਼ਵਾਲ ॥੩੨॥
1396.t: base gashat jo dhaulate be zavaal ||32||
1396.e: ‘Examine the deed and open your tongue (to speak).(32)

1396.g: ਚੁ ਬਿਨਸ਼ਸਤ ਬਰ ਤਖ਼ਤ ਮਾਨੋ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
1396.t: ch binashasat bar takhhat maano maheep ||
1396.e: ‘Read from the paper and narrate,

1396.g: ਬ ਪੁਰਸ਼ਸ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਸਹੇ ਹਫ਼ਤ ਦੀਪ ॥੩੩॥
1396.t: b purashas dharaamadh sahe haphat dheep ||33||
1396.e: ‘How much I had given to each of them.‘(33)

1396.g: ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਬ ਪੇਸ਼ੀਨ ਕਾਗ਼ਜ਼ ਬਿਯਾਰ ॥
1396.t: bigoyadh b pesheen kaag(h)z biyaar ||
1396.e: When he (the scribe) heard the command of the King,

1396.g: ਚਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦਅਮ ਮਨ ਬ ਪਿਸਰਾ ਚਹਾਰ ॥੩੪॥
1396.t: ch bakhhasheedham man b pisaraa chahaar ||34||
1396.e: Who had earned the praises and the status same as the gods.(34)

1396.g: ਦਬੀਰੇ ਕਲਮ ਬਰ ਕਲਮ ਜਨ ਗਿਰਿਫ਼ਤ ॥
1396.t: dhabeere kalam bar kalam jan giriphat ||
1396.e: (King stressed,) ‘Present to me, whatever beneficence I had endowed to,

1396.g: ਜਵਾਬੇ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਰਾ ਅਲਮਬਰ ਗਰਿਫ਼ਤ ॥੩੫॥
1396.t: javaabe sukhhan raa alamabar gariphat ||35||
1396.e: ‘You, the lights of the world and stars of Yaman.‘(35)

1396.g: ਬਗੁਫ਼ਤਾ ਚਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਏਸ਼ਾ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1396.t: baguphataa ch bakhhasheedh eshaa hazaar ||
1396.e: The first son replied, ‘Most of the elephants were killed in the wars,

1396.g: ਬ ਕਾਗ਼ਜ਼ ਬੁਬੀਂ ਤਾ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਨਸ ਬਿਯਾਰ ॥੩੬॥
1396.t: b kaag(h)z bubee(n) taa zubaanas biyaar ||36||
1396.e: ‘And the ones which were saved, I gave them out in charity like you do.‘(36)

1396.g: ਬ ਕਾਗ਼ਜ਼ ਬੁਬੀਂ ਤਾ ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥
1396.t: b kaag(h)z bubee(n) taa bigoyadh zubaa ||
1396.e: He asked the second son, ‘What have you done with the horses?‘

1396.g: ਚਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ਹਰਕਸ ਅਜ਼ਾ ॥੩੭॥
1396.t: ch bakhhasheedh shudh bakhhash harakas azaa ||37||
1396.e: (He replied), ‘I have given out some in charity and rest faced the death.‘(37)

1396.g: ਚੁ ਬਿਸ਼ਨੀਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਅਜ਼ ਮਹੀਪਾਨ ਮਾਨ ॥
1396.t: ch bishaneedh sukhhan az maheepaan maan ||
1396.e: (He) asked the third one to show him his camels.

1396.g: ਫ਼ਰਿਸ਼ਤਹ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਚੂੰ ਮਲਾਯਕ ਮਕਾਨ ॥੩੮॥
1396.t: pharishateh siphat choo(n) malaayak makaan ||38||
1396.e: ‘To whom have you denoted them?‘(38)

1396.g: ਬਯਾਰੀ ਮਰਾ ਪੇਸ਼ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦਹ ਮਨ ॥
1396.t: bayaaree maraa pesh bakhhasheedheh man ||
1396.e: He replied, ‘A number of them died in the wars,

1396.g: ਚਰਾਗ਼ੇ ਜਹਾ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਯਮਨ ॥੩੯॥
1396.t: charaag(h)e jahaa aaphataabe yaman ||39||
1396.e: ‘And the remaining I gave in charity.‘(39)

1396.g: ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਕਿ ਮੁਰਦੰਦ ਬਾਜੇ ਮੁਹਿੰਮ ॥
1396.t: bigoyadh k muradha(n)dh baaje muhi(n)m ||
1396.e: Then (he) asked the fourth one, ‘Oh, you the gentle one,‘

1396.g: ਕਿ ਮਾ ਹਮ ਬਸਾ ਫ਼ੀਲ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦਹਅਮ ॥੪੦॥
1396.t: k maa ham basaa pheel bakhhasheedhaham ||40||
1396.e: ‘You, the one deserving royal canopy and the throne,(40)

1396.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਰਾ ਬਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਅਪਸ ਚ ਕਰਦ ॥
1396.t: dhig(h)r raa bapurasheedh apas ch karadh ||
1396.e: ‘Where is the gift, which I granted you;

1396.g: ਕਿ ਬਾਜ਼ੇ ਬਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦੁ ਬਾਜ਼ੇ ਬਿਮੁਰਦ ॥੪੧॥
1396.t: k baaze babakhhasheedh baaze bimuradh ||41||
1396.e: ‘One seed of moong and the half that of gram?‘(41)

1396.g: ਸਿਅਮ ਰਾ ਬਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਸ਼ੁਤਰਾ ਨੁਮਾ ॥
1396.t: siam raa bapurasheedh shutaraa numaa ||
1396.e: (He replied,) ‘If your command permits, I may present you,

1396.g: ਕੁਜਾ ਤੋ ਬਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਏ ਜਾਨ ਮਾ ॥੪੨॥
1396.t: kujaa to babakhhasheedh e jaan maa ||42||
1396.e: ‘All the elephants, horses and many a camels.‘(42)

1396.g: ਬਗੁਫ਼ਤਾ ਕਿ ਬਾਜ਼ੇ ਬਕਾਰ ਆਮਦੰਦ ॥
1396.t: baguphataa k baaze bakaar aamadha(n)dh ||
1396.e: He brought forward ten hundred thousand stupefied elephants,

1396.g: ਬਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਬੇਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ਆਮਦੰਦ ॥੪੩॥
1396.t: babakhhash a(n)dharoo(n) beshumaar aamadha(n)dh ||43||
1396.e: Which were adorned with gold and silver trappings.(43)

1396.g: ਚੁਅਮ ਰਾ ਬਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਕਿ ਏ ਨੇਕ ਬਖ਼ਤ ॥
1396.t: chuam raa bapurasheedh k e nek bakhhat ||
1396.e: He presented ten to twelve thousand horses,

1396.g: ਸਜ਼ਾਵਾਰ ਦੇਹੀਮ ਸਾਯਾਨ ਤਖ਼ਤ ॥੪੪॥
1396.t: sazaavaar dheheem saayaan takhhat ||44||
1396.e: Adorned with numerous gilded saddles.(44)

1396.g: ਕੁਜਾ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਸ਼ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਫ਼ਹੀਮ ॥
1396.t: kujaa gashat bakhhashash tumaaraa phaheem ||
1396.e: He brought along steel helmets and armours,

1396.g: ਯਕੇ ਦਾਨਹ ਮੁੰਗੋ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਨੁਖ਼ਦ ਨੀਮ ॥੪੫॥
1396.t: yake dhaaneh mu(n)go dhig(h)r nukhhadh neem ||45||
1396.e: And also gilded animal-blankets, arrows, and expensive swords,(45)

1396.g: ਸ਼ਵਦ ਗਰ ਹੁਕਮ ਤਾ ਬਿਯਾਰੇਮ ਪੇਸ਼ ॥
1396.t: shavadh gar hukam taa biyaarem pesh ||
1396.e: The camels from Baghdad, which were laden with ornamented clothes,

1396.g: ਹਮਹ ਫ਼ੀਲੁ ਅਸਪੋ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਸ਼ੁਤਰ ਬੇਸ਼ ॥੪੬॥
1396.t: hameh pheel asapo azo shutar besh ||46||
1396.e: Plenty of gold, great number of clothes,(46)

1396.g: ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕਰਦ ਫ਼ੀਲੇ ਦੋ ਦਹਿ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਮਸਤ ॥
1396.t: nazar karadh pheele dho dheh hazaar masat ||
1396.e: Ten neelams (precious stones), and many Dinars (coins),

1396.g: ਪੁਰ ਅਜ਼ ਜ਼ਰ ਬਾਰੋ ਹਮਹ ਨੁਕਰਹ ਬਸਤ ॥੪੭॥
1396.t: pur az zar baaro hameh nukareh basat ||47||
1396.e: By looking at them even eyes shuddered.(47)

1396.g: ਹੁਮਾ ਅਸਪ ਪਾ ਸਦ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਆਵਰੀਦ ॥
1396.t: humaa asap paa sadh hazaar aavareedh ||
1396.e: Through one seed of moong, he raised a city,

1396.g: ਹੁਮਾ ਜ਼ਰ ਜ਼ੀਨ ਬੇਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ਆਵਰੀਦ ॥੪੮॥
1396.t: humaa zar zeen beshumaar aavareedh ||48||
1396.e: Which was given the name of Moongi-patam.(48)

1396.g: ਹਮਹ ਖ਼ੋਦ ਖ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਾਨ ਬਰਗਸ਼ਤਵਾ ॥
1396.t: hameh khhodh khhuphataan baragashatavaa ||
1396.e: With the other, half of gram-seed, he raised another one,

1396.g: ਬਸੇ ਤੀਰੁ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ੇਰ ਕੀਮਤ ਗਿਰਾ ॥੪੯॥
1396.t: base teer shamasher keemat giraa ||49||
1396.e: And associating with his name, it was called Delhi.(49)

1396.g: ਬਸੇ ਸ਼ੁਤਰ ਬਗਦਾਦ ਜ਼ਰ ਬਫ਼ਤ ਬਾਰ ॥
1396.t: base shutar bagadhaadh zar baphat baar ||
1396.e: The King approved this innovation and honoured him,

1396.g: ਜ਼ਰੋ ਜਾਮਹ ਨੀਮ ਆਸਤੀਂ ਬੇਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ॥੫੦॥
1396.t: zaro jaameh neem aasatee(n) beshumaar ||50||
1396.e: From then on gave him the name as Raja Daleep.(50)

1396.g: ਕਿ ਦਹਿ ਨੀਲੁ ਦਹਿ ਪਦਮ ਦੀਨਾਰ ਜ਼ਰਦ ॥
1396.t: k dheh neel dheh padham dheenaar zaradh ||
1396.e: The omens of royalty, which were depicted in him,

1397.g: ਕਜ਼ੋ ਦੀਦਹ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਦੀਦਹੇ ਦੋਸਤ ਸਰਦ ॥੫੧॥
1397.t: kazo dheedheh shudh dheedhahe dhosat saradh ||51||
1397.e: Made him worthy of the throne.(51)

1397.g: ਕਿ ਯਕ ਮੁੰਗ ਯਕ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਜ਼ੋ ਕਾਮ ਸ਼ੁਦ ॥
1397.t: k yak mu(n)g yak shahir zo kaam shudh ||
1397.e: Such a man deserved gilded canopy, royal stamp and coinage,

1397.g: ਕਿ ਮੂੰਗੀ ਪਟਨ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਓ ਨਾਮ ਸ਼ੁਦ ॥੫੨॥
1397.t: k moo(n)gee paTan shahir o naam shudh ||52||
1397.e: And thousands of honours were sacrificed on to him.(52)

1397.g: ਕਿ ਨੀਮਿ ਨੁਖ਼ਦ ਰਾ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਬਸਤ ॥
1397.t: k neem nukhhadh raa dhig(h)r shahir basat ||
1397.e: The (other) three were fools and possessed tarnished minds.

1397.g: ਕਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਦਿਹਲੀ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਅਸਤ ॥੫੩॥
1397.t: k naame azo shahir dhihalee shudh asat ||53||
1397.e: Their language was rustic and their gait was detestable.(53)

1397.g: ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਆਮਦ ਬ ਤਦਬੀਰ ਮਾਨੋ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
1397.t: khhush aamadh b tadhabeer maano maheep ||
1397.e: He (King) displayed his desire, as he (son) was to be given the kingdom,

1397.g: ਖ਼ਿਤਾਬਸ਼ ਬਦੋ ਦਾਦ ਰਾਜਹ ਦਲੀਪ ॥੫੪॥
1397.t: khhitaabash badho dhaadh raajeh dhaleep ||54||
1397.e: He would disclose all his wealth to him (son),(54)

1397.g: ਕਿ ਪੈਦਾ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਮਰਦ ਸ਼ਾਹਨ ਸ਼ਹੀ ॥
1397.t: k paidhaa azo maradh shaahan shahee ||
1397.e: And he would be a suitable person to sit on the throne,

1397.g: ਸਜ਼ਾਵਾਰ ਤਖ਼ਤ ਅਸਤੁ ਤਾਜੋ ਮਹੀ ॥੫੫॥
1397.t: sazaavaar takhhat asat taajo mahee ||55||
1397.e: On account of his high intellect.(55)

1397.g: ਬਜ਼ੇਬਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਮਰਦ ਤਾਜੋ ਨਗ਼ੀਂ ॥
1397.t: bazebadh azo maradh taajo nag(h)ee(n) ||
1397.e: Then, he (the fourth prince) attained the title of Raja Daleep,

1397.g: ਬਰ ਆਂ ਅਕਲੁ ਤਦਬੀਰ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਆਫ਼ਰੀਂ ॥੫੬॥
1397.t: bar aa(n) akal tadhabeer hazaar aapharee(n) ||56||
1397.e: As the King had endowed him the kingdom.(56)

1397.g: ਸਿ ਓ ਅਸਤ ਬੇਅਕਲ ਆਲੂਦਹ ਮਗ਼ਜ਼ ॥
1397.t: s o asat beakal aaloodheh mag(h)z ||
1397.e: The other three were banished from the territory,

1397.g: ਨ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਤਰ ਨ ਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਨਗ਼ਜ਼ ॥੫੭॥
1397.t: n raphataar khhushatar na g(h)uphataar nag(h)z ||57||
1397.e: Because neither they were intelligent nor devoid of bad traits.(57)

1397.g: ਹਮੀ ਖ਼ਾਸਤ ਕਿ ਓਰਾ ਬਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਦਿਹਮ ॥
1397.t: hamee khhaasat k oraa bashaahee dhiham ||
1397.e: He (Daleep) was enthroned on the royal seat,

1397.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਦੌਲਤ ਖ਼ੁਦਸ਼ਰਾ ਅਗਾਹੀ ਦਿਹਮ ॥੫੮॥
1397.t: z dhaualat khhudhasharaa agaahee dhiham ||58||
1397.e: And the door of the treasure was opened for him by the key.(58)

1397.g: ਬਜ਼ੇਬਦ ਕਜ਼ੋ ਰੰਗ ਸ਼ਾਹਨਸ਼ਹੀ ॥
1397.t: bazebadh kazo ra(n)g shaahanashahee ||
1397.e: (The King) endowed the kingdom to him, and, himself, became a freeman,

1397.g: ਕਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸ਼ਊਰ ਅਸਤ ਵ ਮਾਲਕ ਮਹੀ ॥੫੯॥
1397.t: k saahib shuoor asat v maalak mahee ||59||
1397.e: Adoring the ascetic’s garb, he took his way to the jungle (seclusion).(59)

1397.g: ਖ਼ਿਤਾਬਸ਼ ਕਜ਼ੋ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਰਾਜਹ ਦਲੀਪ ॥
1397.t: khhitaabash kazo gashat raajeh dhaleep ||
1397.e: (The poet says),

1397.g: ਖ਼ਿਲਾਫ਼ਤ ਬਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਮਾਨੋ ਮਹੀਪ ॥੬੦॥
1397.t: khhilaaphat babakhhasheedh maano maheep ||60||
1397.e: ‘Oh Saki, the bartender, give me the cup full of green (liquid),

1397.g: ਸਿ ਪਿਸਰਾ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਆਜ਼ਾਦ ਕਰਦ ॥
1397.t: s pisaraa dhig(h)r shaeh aazaadh karadh ||
1397.e: ‘Which I may need at the time of struggle,(60)

1397.g: ਨ ਦਾਨਸ਼ ਪਰਸਤੋ ਨ ਆਜ਼ਾਦ ਮਰਦ ॥੬੧॥
1397.t: n dhaanash parasato na aazaadh maradh ||61||
1397.e: ‘And give me this so that at the time of assessment,

1397.g: ਕਿ ਓਰਾ ਬਰੋ ਜ਼ਰ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਦ ॥
1397.t: k oraa baro zar si(n)ghaasan nishaadh ||
1397.e: ‘I may commence the use of my sword.(61)(2)

1397.g: ਕਲੀਦੇ ਕੁਹਨ ਗੰਜ ਰਾ ਬਰ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੬੨॥
1397.t: kaleedhe kuhan ga(n)j raa bar kushaadh ||62||

1397.g: ਬਦੋ ਦਾਦ ਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਆਜ਼ਾਦ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥
1397.t: badho dhaadh shaahee khhudh aazaadh gashat ||

1397.g: ਬਪੋਸ਼ੀਦ ਦਲਕਸ਼ ਰਵਾ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਬਦਸ਼ਤ ॥੬੩॥
1397.t: baposheedh dhalakash ravaa shudh badhashat ||63||

1397.g: ਬਿਦਿਹ ਸਾਕੀਯਾ ਸਾਗ਼ਰੇ ਸਬਜ਼ ਰੰਗ ॥
1397.t: bidheh saakeeyaa saag(h)re sabaz ra(n)g ||

1397.g: ਕਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਬਕਾਰ ਅਸਤ ਦਰ ਵਕਤ ਜੰਗ ॥੬੪॥
1397.t: k maaraa bakaar asat dhar vakat ja(n)g ||64||

1397.g: ਬ ਮਨ ਦਿਹ ਕਿ ਬਖ਼ਤ ਆਜ਼ਮਾਈ ਕੁਨਮ ॥
1397.t: b man dheh k bakhhat aazamaiee kunam ||

1397.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਤੇਗ਼ੇ ਖ਼ੁਦਸ਼ ਕਾਰਵਾਈ ਕੁਨਮ ॥੬੫॥੨॥
1397.t: z teg(h)e khhudhash kaaravaiee kunam ||65||2||

1397.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫ਼ਤਹ ॥
1397.t: ikOankaar vaahaguroo jee kee phateh ||
1397.e: Glory to God

1397.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦ ਦਾਨਸ਼ ਦਿਹੋ ਦਾਦਗਰ ॥
1397.t: khhudhaava(n)dh dhaanash dhiho dhaadhagar ||
1397.e: God is the endower of all wisdom and justice.

1397.g: ਰਜ਼ਾ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਹੋ ਹਰ ਹੁਨਰ ॥੧॥
1397.t: razaa bakhhash rozee dhiho har hunar ||1||
1397.e: (He) bestows bliss, living and ingenuity.(1)

1397.g: ਅਮਾ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿੰਦ ਓ ਦਸਤਗੀਰ ॥
1397.t: amaa bakhhash bakhhashi(n)dh o dhasatageer ||
1397.e: (He) is benevolent and helper,

1397.g: ਕੁਸ਼ਾਯਸ਼ ਕੁਨੋ ਰਹਿ ਨੁਮਾਯਸ਼ ਪਜ਼ੀਰ ॥੨॥
1397.t: kushaayash kuno reh numaayash pazeer ||2||
1397.e: (He) disintegrates the bondage, and guides our thought.(2)

1397.g: ਹਿਕਾਯਤ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦਮ ਯਕੇ ਨੇਕ ਮਰਦ ॥
1397.t: hikaayat shuneedham yake nek maradh ||
1397.e: Listen now, the Tale of a kind man,

1397.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਦਉਰ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਬਰਾਵੁਰਦ ਗਰਦ ॥੩॥
1397.t: k az dhaur dhushaman baraavuradh garadh ||3||
1397.e: Who trampled the enemies in the dust.(3)

1397.g: ਖ਼ਸਮ ਅਫ਼ਕਨੋ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਚੀਂ ਦਿਲ ਫ਼ਰਾਜ਼ ॥
1397.t: khhasam aphakano shaeh chee(n) dhil pharaaz ||
1397.e: He, the King of China, was very shrewd and openhearted.

1397.g: ਗ਼ਰੀਬੁਲ ਨਿਵਾਜ਼ੋ ਗ਼ਨੀਮੁਲ ਗੁਦਾਜ਼ ॥੪॥
1397.t: g(h)reebul nivaazo g(h)neemul gudhaaz ||4||
1397.e: He elevated the poor but looked down upon the egoists.(4)

1397.g: ਜਿ ਰਜ਼ਮੋ ਬ ਬਜ਼ਮੋ ਹਮਹ ਬੰਦੁਬਸਤ ॥
1397.t: j razamo b bazamo hameh ba(n)dhubasat ||
1397.e: He was adept in the war and in all the (court) managements.

1397.g: ਕਿ ਬਿਸਯਾਰ ਤੇਗ਼ ਅਸਤ ਹੁਸ਼ਯਾਰ ਦਸਤ ॥੫॥
1397.t: k bisayaar teg(h) asat hushayaar dhasat ||5||
1397.e: In swordsmanship, he was very swift in the movements of his hands.(5)

1397.g: ਨਿਵਾਲਹ ਪਿਯਾਲਹ ਜਿ ਰਜ਼ਮੋ ਬ ਬਜ਼ਮ ॥
1397.t: nivaaleh piyaaleh j razamo b bazam ||
1397.e: His masterly sword and gun actions were much proficient.

1397.g: ਤੁ ਗੁਫ਼ਤੀ ਕਿ ਦੀਗਰ ਯਲੇ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਬ ਬਜ਼ਮ ॥੬॥
1397.t: t guphatee k dheegar yale shudh b bazam ||6||
1397.e: He was second to none in eating and drinking and, both, in his fighting feats and court manners, You would think, ‘Could there be any one like him?’(6)

1397.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਤੀਰੋ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਆਮੁਖ਼ਤਹ ਸ਼ੁਦ ॥
1397.t: z teero tupha(n)g ham ch aamukhhateh shudh ||
1397.e: He was so much proficient in throwing the arrows and shooting the gun,

1397.g: ਤੁ ਗੋਈ ਕਿ ਦਰ ਸ਼ਿਕਮ ਅੰਦੋਖ਼ਤਹ ਸ਼ੁਦ ॥੭॥
1397.t: t goiee k dhar shikam a(n)dhokhhateh shudh ||7||
1397.e: That you would reflect, he was trained in his mother’s abdomen.(7)

1397.g: ਚੁ ਮਾਲਸ਼ ਗਿਰਾਨਸ਼ ਮਤਾਯਸ਼ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1397.t: ch maalash giraanash mataayash azeem ||
1397.e: He had abundance of wealth.

1397.g: ਕਿ ਮੁਲਕਸ਼ ਬਸੇ ਅਸਤ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਸ਼ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੮॥
1397.t: k mulakash base asat bakhhashash kareem ||8||
1397.e: He ruled over many counties through Karim, the Bountiful.(8)

1397.g: ਅਜ਼ੋ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਬ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਸ਼ੁਦਸਤ ॥
1397.t: azo baadhashaahee b aakhhar shudhasat ||
1397.e: (Abruptly) his kingdom was terminated.

1397.g: ਨਿਸ਼ਸਤੰਦ ਵਜ਼ੀਰਾਨ ਓ ਪੇਸ਼ ਪਸਤ ॥੯॥
1397.t: nishasata(n)dh vazeeraan o pesh pasat ||9||
1397.e: And all his Ministers came and positioned themselves around him.(9)

1398.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਤੋ ਪਸ ਕਿਰਾ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਦਿਹਮ ॥
1398.t: z to pas kiraa baadhashaahee dhiham ||
1398.e: (They asked), ‘Who could we endow the kingdom after you?

1398.g: ਕਿਰਾ ਤਾਜ ਇਕਬਾਲ ਬਰ ਸਰ ਨਿਹਮ ॥੧੦॥
1398.t: kiraa taaj ikabaal bar sar niham ||10||
1398.e: ‘And on whose head the crown be replaced and royal canopy entrusted?(10)

1398.g: ਕਿਰਾ ਮਰਦ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ਾਨਹ ਬੇਰੂੰ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1398.t: kiraa maradh az khhaaneh beroo(n) kunadh ||
1398.e: ‘Whom should we get out of his house?

1398.g: ਕਿਰਾ ਬਖ਼ਤ ਇਕਬਾਲ ਬਰ ਸਰ ਨਿਹਦ ॥੧੧॥
1398.t: kiraa bakhhat ikabaal bar sar nihadh ||11||
1398.e: ‘And who should be delegated the power to rule?’(11)

1398.g: ਬ ਹੋਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਦੋ ਦੁ ਚਸ਼ਮ ॥
1398.t: b hosh a(n)dhar aamadh kushaadho dh chasham ||
1398.e: When the King regained the cognisance, opened his both the eyes,

1398.g: ਬਗੁਫ਼ਤਾ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਪੇਸ਼ੀਨ ਰਸਮ ॥੧੨॥
1398.t: baguphataa sukhhan shaeh pesheen rasam ||12||
1398.e: And uttered the words as per his protocol,(12)

1398.g: ਨ ਪਾਓ ਨ ਦਸਤੋ ਨ ਚਸ਼ਮੋ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥
1398.t: n paao na dhasato na chashamo zubaa ||
1398.e: ‘The one who has no feet, no hands, no eyes and no tongue,

1398.g: ਨ ਹੋਸ਼ੋ ਨ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਨ ਹੈਬਤ ਕਸਾ ॥੧੩॥
1398.t: n hosho na hi(n)mat na haibat kasaa ||13||
1398.e: ‘Neither shows cleverness, nor zeal, and possesses no fear.(13)

1398.g: ਨ ਹਉਲੋ ਨ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਨ ਹੀਲਹ ਨ ਹੋਸ਼ ॥
1398.t: n haulo na hi(n)mat na heeleh na hosh ||
1398.e: ‘He has no anxiety, no wit, no lame excuses and no laziness.

1398.g: ਨ ਬੀਨੀ ਨ ਬੀਨਾਯਗੀ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਗੋਸ਼ ॥੧੪॥
1398.t: n beenee na beenaayagee har dh gosh ||14||
1398.e: ‘Neither he can smell and see, nor can hear from both the ears.(14)

1398.g: ਹਰਾ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਹਸਤ ਆਜ਼ਮਾਯਸ਼ ਬਵਦ ॥
1398.t: haraa kas k hasat aazamaayash bavadh ||
1398.e: ‘One who has such eight traits,

1398.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਦਉਰ ਦੀ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹਸ਼ ਬਵਦ ॥੧੫॥
1398.t: vazaa dhaur dhee baadhashaahash bavadh ||15||
1398.e: ‘Enthrone him to run the righteous kingdom.’(15)

1398.g: ਅਜਬਮਾਦ ਦਾਨਾਇ ਦਉਰ ਈਂ ਜਵਾਬ ॥
1398.t: ajabamaadh dhaanai dhaur iee(n) javaab ||
1398.e: The wise man of the time was surprised to hear this.

1398.g: ਸੁਖ਼ਨਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀਗਰ ਕੁਨਦ ਬਾ ਸਵਾਬ ॥੧੬॥
1398.t: sukhhanabaaz dheegar kunadh baa savaab ||16||
1398.e: To clarify he determined to ask again.(16)

1398.g: ਬਕਿੰਗਸ਼ ਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਦਿਰੰਗਸ਼ ਗਿਰਿਫ਼ਤ ॥
1398.t: baki(n)gash dhar aamadh dhira(n)gash giriphat ||
1398.e: He came in the court, pondered over thoroughly,

1398.g: ਜਵਾਬੇ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਰਾ ਬਰੰਗਸ਼ ਗਿਰਿਫ਼ਤ ॥੧੭॥
1398.t: javaabe sukhhan raa bara(n)gash giriphat ||17||
1398.e: And tried to comprehend the (King’s) preposition.(17)

1398.g: ਚਪੋਰਾਸਤਸ਼ ਕਰਦ ਚਰਖੇ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥
1398.t: chaporaasatash karadh charakhe zubaa ||
1398.e: Walking left and right and moving around,

1398.g: ਬਰਾ ਵੁਰਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨੇ ਚੁ ਕੈਬਰ ਕਮਾ ॥੧੮॥
1398.t: baraa vuradh sukhhane ch kaibar kamaa ||18||
1398.e: Suddenly, he brought the words out like the arrows from the bow.(18)

1398.g: ਕਿ ਏ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਹੁਸ਼ਿਯਾਰ ਆਜ਼ਾਦ ਮਗ਼ਜ਼ ॥
1398.t: k e shaeh hushiyaar aazaadh mag(h)z ||
1398.e: ‘O, King! You are (man of) unconstrained thinking.

1398.g: ਚਿਰਾਮੇ ਤੁ ਗੋਈ ਦਰੀਂ ਕਾਰ ਨਗ਼ਜ਼ ॥੧੯॥
1398.t: chiraame ta goiee dharee(n) kaar nag(h)z ||19||
1398.e: ‘I am surprised at whatever you have remarked.(19)

1398.g: ਕਸੇ ਰਾ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਕਾਰ ਈ ਦਰ ਜ਼ਮਾ ॥
1398.t: kase raa shavadh kaar iee dhar zamaa ||
1398.e: ‘If there is any worldly assignment of such magnitude,

1398.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਹਸਤ ਐਬਅਸਤ ਜ਼ਾਹਰ ਜਹਾ ॥੨੦॥
1398.t: vazaa hasat aaibasat zaahar jahaa ||20||
1398.e: ‘It is sin to leave that to the world to handle (itself).(20)

1398.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਹਸਤ ਐਬੋ ਤੁ ਗੋਈ ਹੁਨਰ ॥
1398.t: k iee(n) hasat aaibo ta goiee hunar ||
1398.e: ‘Oh, the King of the earth and the seas!

1398.g: ਕਿ ਏ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਸ਼ਾਹਾਨ ਹਮਹ ਬਹਰ ਬਰ ॥੨੧॥
1398.t: k e shaeh shaahaan hameh bahar bar ||21||
1398.e: ‘How do you call these eight drawbacks as the virtues?(21)

1398.g: ਨ ਦਰ ਜੰਗ ਪੁਸ਼ਤੋ ਨ ਦੁਸ਼ਨਾਮ ਦਾਦ ॥
1398.t: n dhar ja(n)g pushato na dhushanaam dhaadh ||
1398.e: ‘Neither you have ever shown your back in the fight, nor abused any body.

1398.g: ਨ ਅੰਗੁਸ਼ਤਬਰ ਹਰਫ਼ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਨਿਹਾਦ ॥੨੨॥
1398.t: n a(n)gushatabar haraph dhushaman nihaadh ||22||
1398.e: ‘You have never even pointed a finger at (the enemies) writ.(22)

1398.g: ਨ ਆਰਾਮ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਨ ਆਜ਼ਾਰ ਦੋਸਤ ॥
1398.t: n aaraam dhushaman na aazaar dhosat ||
1398.e: ‘Neither you have afflicted the friends, nor the enemies, to enjoy the comforts.

1398.g: ਜਵਾਬੇ ਗਦਾਰਾ ਅਦੂਰਾ ਬਪੋਸਤ ॥੨੩॥
1398.t: javaabe gadhaaraa adhooraa baposat ||23||
1398.e: ‘You never disappointed the seekers, nor let enemy unthrashed.(23)

1398.g: ਨਵੀਸ਼ਿੰਦਹ ਰਾ ਜਾ ਨ ਹਰਫ਼ੋ ਨਿਹਦ ॥
1398.t: naveeshi(n)dheh raa jaa na harapho nihadh ||
1398.e: ‘You never let a scribe to write the vices,

1398.g: ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਰਾ ਬਹਕ ਜਾਇ ਸ਼ਰਫ਼ੋ ਦਿਹਦ ॥੨੪॥
1398.t: sukhhan raa bahak jai sharapho dhihadh ||24||
1398.e: ‘And have always given prominence to the truth.(24)

1398.g: ਨ ਉਸਤਾਦ ਰਾ ਦਾਦ ਜਾਏ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ॥
1398.t: n usataadh raa dhaadh jaae sukhhan ||
1398.e: ‘You have never given a cause to your teacher to admonish you,

1398.g: ਫ਼ਰਾਮੋਸ਼ਗੀ ਚੂੰ ਬਕਾਰੇ ਕੁਹਨ ॥੨੫॥
1398.t: pharaamoshagee choo(n) bakaare kuhan ||25||
1398.e: ‘Why have you forgotten your good deeds?(25)

1398.g: ਬ ਬਦ ਮਸਲਿਹਤ ਕਸ ਨ ਦਾਦਨ ਦਿਗਰ ॥
1398.t: b badh masalihat kas na dhaadhan dhigar ||
1398.e: ‘Be in your faculty. How can a person dispute

1398.g: ਬਿਹਸ ਨਾਮ ਓ ਚੂੰ ਤੁ ਗੋਯਦ ਹੁਨਰ ॥੨੬॥
1398.t: bihas naam o choo(n) ta goyadh hunar ||26||
1398.e: the virtues associated with your name?(26)

1398.g: ਨ ਬੀਨਦ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਜ਼ਨ ਬ ਚਸ਼ਮੋ ਖ਼ੁਦਸ਼ ॥
1398.t: n beenadh dhig(h)r zan b chashamo khhudhash ||
1398.e: ‘Neither you have given disdainful looks to any woman,

1398.g: ਨ ਬਦ ਕਾਰ ਕਸ ਕਰਦ ਨਜ਼ਰੇ ਬਦਸ਼ ॥੨੭॥
1398.t: n badh kaar kas karadh nazare badhash ||27||
1398.e: ‘Nor you have thought bad of any person’s work.(27)

1398.g: ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕਰਦ ਕਸ ਬਰ ਨ ਹਰਫ਼ੇ ਹਰਾਮ ॥
1398.t: nazar karadh kas bar na haraphe haraam ||
1398.e: ‘You have not objected to the improper act of any man.

1398.g: ਨਿਗਹ ਦਾਸ਼ਤ ਬਰ ਸ਼ੁਕਰ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਮੁਦਾਮ ॥੨੮॥
1398.t: nigeh dhaashat bar shukar yazadhaa mudhaam ||28||
1398.e: ‘You have been always referring to the God, Almighty, in gratitude.’(28)

1398.g: ਨਜ਼ਰ ਰਾ ਬ ਬਦਕਾਰ ਦੀਗਰ ਬ ਬਸਤ ॥
1398.t: nazar raa b badhakaar dheegar b basat ||
1398.e: (The King Replied) ‘Look consciously, the one who is blind,

1398.g: ਸ਼ਨਾਸੀ ਤੁ ਤਹਕੀਕ ਓ ਕੋਰ ਹਸਤ ॥੨੯॥
1398.t: shanaasee ta tahakeek o kor hasat ||29||
1398.e: ‘(He) is keeping his vision restrained from other’s vices.(29)

1398.g: ਕਦਮ ਰਾ ਨ ਦਾਰਦ ਬ ਬਦਕਾਰ ਕਾਰ ॥
1398.t: kadham raa na dhaaradh b badhakaar kaar ||
1398.e: ‘(The lame) has no feet to step into bad deeds, and, in the war,

1398.g: ਨ ਦਰ ਜੰਗ ਪਸਪਾਉ ਪੁਸ਼ਤੇ ਬਰਾਰ ॥੩੦॥
1398.t: n dhar ja(n)g pasapaau pushate baraar ||30||
1398.e: he does not turn back like thousand others.(30)

1398.g: ਨ ਦਰਕਾਰ ਦੁਜ਼ਦੀ ਨ ਦਿਲ ਬਿਸ਼ਕਨੀ ॥
1398.t: n dharakaar dhuzadhee na dhil bishakanee ||
1398.e: ‘Neither he goes to commit theft to cause distress to dissimilar,

1398.g: ਨ ਖ਼ਾਨਹ ਖ਼ੁਰਮ ਬਾਜ਼ ਨਹ ਰਹਜ਼ਨੀ ॥੩੧॥
1398.t: n khhaaneh khhuram baaz neh rahazanee ||31||
1398.e: ‘Nor he goes out to take alcohol, nor does he execute cheating.(31)

1398.g: ਬਨਾਕਸ ਦੁਆਏ ਨ ਗੋਯਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ॥
1398.t: banaakas dhuaae na goyadh sukhhan ||
1398.e: ‘(The mute) does not spell out bad words,

1398.g: ਬ ਖ਼ਾਹਸ਼ ਖ਼ਰਾਸ਼ੀ ਨ ਜੋਈ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ॥੩੨॥
1398.t: b khhaahash khharaashee na joiee sukhhan ||32||
1398.e: ‘And does not desire to use ill-inflicting words.(32)

1398.g: ਬ ਬਦਕਾਰ ਕਸ ਦਰ ਨ ਦਾਦੰਦ ਪਾਇ ॥
1398.t: b badhakaar kas dhar na dhaadha(n)dh pai ||
1398.e: ‘(He) does not interfere into other people affairs,

1398.g: ਕਿ ਓ ਪਾਇ ਲੰਗ ਅਸਤੁ ਗੋਈ ਬਜਾਇ ॥੩੩॥
1398.t: k o pai la(n)g asat goiee bajai ||33||
1398.e: ‘It is true, when one has impaired (hands),(33)

1399.g: ਬ ਦੁਜ਼ਦੀ ਮਤਾਰਾ ਨ ਆਲੂਦਹ ਦਸਤ ॥
1399.t: b dhuzadhee mataaraa na aaloodheh dhasat ||
1399.e: ‘(He) does not handle the stolen goods,

1399.g: ਬ ਖ਼ੁਰਸ਼ੇ ਹਰਾਮੋ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਯਦ ਨ ਦਸਤ ॥੩੪॥
1399.t: b khhurashe haraamo kushaayadh na dhasat ||34||
1399.e: ‘Because he cannot stretch his hands to grab other person’s belongings.(34)

1399.g: ਬ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਦਸਤ ਖ਼ਾਹੰਦ ਨ ਗੀਰੰਦ ਮਾਲ ॥
1399.t: b khhudh dhasat khhaaha(n)dh na geera(n)dh maal ||
1399.e: ‘(He) does not wish to touch other people’s effects,

1399.g: ਨ ਰਇਯਤ ਖ਼ਰਾਸ਼ੀ ਨ ਆਜਜ਼ ਜ਼ਵਾਲ ॥੩੫॥
1399.t: n riyat khharaashee na aajaz zavaal ||35||
1399.e: ‘He does not bother his subject and the poor are not trodden.(35)

1399.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਜ਼ਨ ਨ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਦਸਤ ਅੰਦਾਖ਼ਤਨ ॥
1399.t: dhig(h)r zan na khhudh dhasat a(n)dhaakhhatan ||
1399.e: ‘Neither he mishandles other person’s woman,

1399.g: ਰਈਯਤ ਖ਼ੁਲਾਸਹ ਨ ਬਰ ਤਾਖ਼ਤਨ ॥੩੬॥
1399.t: rieeyat khhulaaseh na bar taakhhatan ||36||
1399.e: ‘Nor he infringes with the independence of his subject.(36)

1399.g: ਬਖ਼ੁਦ ਦਸਤ ਰਿਸ਼ਵਤ ਨ ਆਲੂਦਹ ਕਰਦ ॥
1399.t: bakhhudh dhasat rishavat na aaloodheh karadh ||
1399.e: ‘He does not defile his hands by accepting bribes.

1399.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਬਰਾਵੁਰਦ ਗਰਦ ॥੩੭॥
1399.t: k az shaeh dhushaman baraavuradh garadh ||37||
1399.e: ‘Rather he raises them to put to dust the foes of the king.(37)

1399.g: ਨ ਜਾਏ ਅਦੂਰਾ ਦਿਹਦ ਵਕਤ ਜੰਗ ॥
1399.t: n jaae adhooraa dhihadh vakat ja(n)g ||
1399.e: ‘In the jungle he does not give chance to the enemy,

1399.g: ਬੁਬਾਰਸ਼ ਦਿਹਦ ਤੇਗ਼ ਤਰਕਸ਼ ਖ਼ਤੰਗ ॥੩੮॥
1399.t: bubaarash dhihadh teg(h) tarakash khhata(n)g ||38||
1399.e: ‘By throwing arrows and brandishing the sword.(38)

1399.g: ਨ ਰਾਮਸ਼ ਦਿਹਦ ਅਸਪ ਰਾ ਵਕਤ ਕਾਰ ॥
1399.t: n raamash dhihadh asap raa vakat kaar ||
1399.e: ‘During the action he do not let the horses rest,

1399.g: ਨ ਜਾਯਸ਼ ਅਦੂਰਾ ਦਿਹਦ ਦਰ ਦਿਯਾਰ ॥੩੯॥
1399.t: n jaayash adhooraa dhihadh dhar dhiyaar ||39||
1399.e: ‘And does not let the enemy enter the country.(39)

1399.g: ਕਿ ਬੇ ਦਸਤ ਓ ਹਸਤ ਗੋ ਪੁਰ ਹੁਨਰ ॥
1399.t: k be dhasat o hasat go pur hunar ||
1399.e: ‘The one who exists having no hands, is unblemished,

1399.g: ਬ ਆਲੂਦਗੀ ਦਰ ਨ ਬਸਤਨ ਕਮਰ ॥੪੦॥
1399.t: b aaloodhagee dhar na basatan kamar ||40||
1399.e: ‘Because he cannot not indulge in the bad deeds.(40)

1399.g: ਨ ਗੋਯਦ ਕਸੇ ਬਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਜ਼ੀਂ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਨ ॥
1399.t: n goyadh kase badh sukhhan zee(n) zubaan ||
1399.e: ‘The one who does not use one’s tongue (negatively),

1399.g: ਕਿ ਓ ਬੇ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਨਸਤ ਜ਼ਾਹਰ ਜਹਾਨ ॥੪੧॥
1399.t: k o be zubaanasat zaahar jahaan ||41||
1399.e: ‘That tongue-less gets fame in the world.(41)

1399.g: ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦਨ ਨ ਬਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਕਸਰਾ ਬਗੋਸ਼ ॥
1399.t: shuneedhan na badh sukhhan kasaraa bagosh ||
1399.e: ‘One who does not listen to the back-biting talks,

1399.g: ਕਿ ਓ ਹਸਤ ਬੇਗੋਸ਼ ਗੋਈ ਬਹੋਸ਼ ॥੪੨॥
1399.t: k o hasat begosh goiee bahosh ||42||
1399.e: ‘He is like a deaf-mute.(42)

1399.g: ਕਿ ਪਸ ਪਰਦਹ ਚੁਗ਼ਲੀ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦਨ ਨ ਕਸ ॥
1399.t: k pas paradheh chug(h)lee shuneedhan na kas ||
1399.e: ‘The one who does not think the ill of any body even in adversity,

1399.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਸ਼ਨਾਸੀ ਕਿ ਗੋਈ ਸ਼ਹਸ ॥੪੩॥
1399.t: vazaa khhudh shanaasee k goiee shahas ||43||
1399.e: ‘(He is) considered as worthy as your king.(43)

1399.g: ਕਸੇ ਕਾਰ ਬਦਰਾ ਨ ਗੀਰੰਦ ਬੋਇ ॥
1399.t: kase kaar badharaa na geera(n)dh boi ||
1399.e: ‘One who is not receptive to hear against any body,

1399.g: ਕਿ ਓ ਹਸਤ ਬੇ ਬੀਨਿਓ ਨੇਕ ਖ਼ੋਇ ॥੪੪॥
1399.t: k o hasat be beenio nek khhoi ||44||
1399.e: ‘He is without an ego and is of good nature.(44)

1399.g: ਨ ਹਉਲੋ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਹਸਤ ਜੁਜ਼ਬਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾਇ ॥
1399.t: n haulo dhig(h)r hasat juzabaa khhudhai ||
1399.e: ‘Except God, one who does not fear any body,

1399.g: ਕਿ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਵਰਾ ਰਾ ਦਰਾਰਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪੫॥
1399.t: k hi(n)mat varaa raa dharaaradh z pai ||45||
1399.e: ‘He treads upon the enemy eliminating him in the dust.(45)

1399.g: ਬ ਹੋਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਹਮਹ ਵਕਤ ਜੰਗ ॥
1399.t: b hosh a(n)dhar aamadh hameh vakat ja(n)g ||
1399.e: ‘He remains alert through out the battle,

1399.g: ਕਿ ਕੋਸ਼ਸ਼ ਕੁਨਦ ਪਾਇ ਬ ਤੀਰੋ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥੪੬॥
1399.t: k koshash kunadh pai b teero tupha(n)g ||46||
1399.e: ‘And uses hands and feet to throw arrows and shoots guns.(46)

1399.g: ਕਿ ਦਰਕਾਰ ਇਨਸਾਫ ਓ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਅਸਤ ॥
1399.t: k dharakaar inasaaf o hi(n)mat asat ||
1399.e: ‘To do the justice, he always girds up his lions,

1399.g: ਕਿ ਦਰ ਪੇਸ਼ ਗੁਰਬਾਇ ਓ ਆਜਜ਼ ਅਸਤ ॥੪੭॥
1399.t: k dhar pesh gurbai o aajaz asat ||47||
1399.e: ‘And remains meek in the company of the meek.(47)

1399.g: ਨ ਹੀਲਹ ਕੁਨਦ ਵਕਤ ਦਰ ਕਾਰ ਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1399.t: n heeleh kunadh vakat dhar kaar zaar ||
1399.e: ‘Neither he depicts any hesitation during the war,

1399.g: ਨ ਹੈਬਤ ਕੁਨਦ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨਾ ਬੇਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ॥੪੮॥
1399.t: n haibat kunadh dhushamanaa beshumaar ||48||
1399.e: ‘Nor he gets scared while facing gigantic enemies.(48)

1399.g: ਹਰਾ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਜ਼ੀਂ ਹਸਤ ਗਾਜ਼ੀ ਬਵਦ ॥
1399.t: haraa kas k zee(n) hasat gaazee bavadh ||
1399.e: ‘If there has been such a dauntless person,

1399.g: ਬ ਕਾਰੇ ਜਹਾ ਰਜ਼ਮ ਸਾਜ਼ੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੪੯॥
1399.t: b kaare jahaa razam saazee kunadh ||49||
1399.e: ‘Who remains prepared for war remaining domesticated,(49)

1399.g: ਕਸੇ ਰਾ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਕਾਰ ਆਯਦ ਪਸੰਦ ॥
1399.t: kase raa k iee(n) kaar aayadh pasa(n)dh ||
1399.e: ‘And his operations are approved by people,

1399.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਜਹਾ ਅਰਜ਼ਮੰਦ ॥੫੦॥
1399.t: vazaa shaeh baashadh jahaa arazama(n)dh ||50||
1399.e: ‘He is revered as the saviour king.’(50)

1399.g: ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦ ਈਂ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਦਉਰ ਦਾਨਾ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ॥
1399.t: shuneedh iee(n) sukhhan dhaur dhaanaa vazeer ||
1399.e: Thus he had spoken to the wise minister,

1399.g: ਕਿ ਆਕਲ ਸ਼ਨਾਸ ਅਸਤ ਪੋਜ਼ਸ਼ ਪਜ਼ੀਰ ॥੫੧॥
1399.t: k aakal shanaas asat pozash pazeer ||51||
1399.e: Who was intelligent enough to acquiesce to these exhortations.(51)

1399.g: ਕਸੇ ਰਾ ਸ਼ਨਾਸਦ ਬ ਅਕਲੇ ਬਿਹੀ ॥
1399.t: kase raa shanaasadh b akale bihee ||
1399.e: (Minister:) ‘Adopt a person, who manifests wisdom,

1399.g: ਮਰੋ ਰਾ ਬਿਦਿਹ ਤਾਜੁ ਤਖ਼ਤੋ ਮਹੀ ॥੫੨॥
1399.t: maro raa bidheh taaj takhhato mahee ||52||
1399.e: ‘Let him rule the earth by occupying the throne and crown.(52)

1399.g: ਬ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਮਹੀ ਤਖ਼ਤ ਤਾਜ ॥
1399.t: b bakhhasheedh o raa mahee takhhat taaj ||
1399.e: ‘Endow him the throne and power to rule,

1399.g: ਗਰ ਓ ਰਾ ਸ਼ਨਾਸੀ ਰਈਯਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ਼ ॥੫੩॥
1399.t: gar o raa shanaasee rieeyat nivaaz ||53||
1399.e: ‘Provided he has the ability to recognise the public.’(53)

1399.g: ਬ ਹੈਰਤ ਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਬਪਿਸਰਾ ਚਹਾਰ ॥
1399.t: b hairat dhar aamadh bapisaraa chahaar ||
1399.e: All the four sons were amazed to hear all this.

1399.g: ਕਸੇ ਗੋਇ ਗੀਰਦ ਹਮਹ ਵਕਤ ਕਾਰ ॥੫੪॥
1399.t: kase goi geeradh hameh vakat kaar ||54||
1399.e: Who will pick the ball now? They pondered.(54)

1399.g: ਹਰਾ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਰਾ ਅਕਲ ਯਾਰੀ ਦਿਹਦ ॥
1399.t: haraa kas k raa akal yaaree dhihadh ||
1399.e: One, whose intelligence supports him,

1399.g: ਬ ਕਾਰੇ ਜਹਾ ਕਾਮਗਾਰੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੫੫॥
1399.t: b kaare jahaa kaamagaaree kunadh ||55||
1399.e: And whose desires are fulfilled.(55)

1399.g: ਬਿਦਿਹ ਸਾਕੀਯਾ ਸਾਗ਼ਰੇ ਸਬਜ਼ ਰੰਗ ॥
1399.t: bidheh saakeeyaa saag(h)re sabaz ra(n)g ||

1399.g: ਕਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਬਕਾਰ ਅਸਤ ਦਰ ਵਕਤ ਜੰਗ ॥੫੬॥
1399.t: k maaraa bakaar asat dhar vakat ja(n)g ||56||

1399.g: ਬਿਦਿਹ ਸਾਕੀਯਾ ਸਾਗ਼ਰੇ ਨੈਨ ਪਾਨ ॥
1399.t: bidheh saakeeyaa saag(h)re nain paan ||
1399.e: (The poet says), “Oh! Saki, bring me the cup full of eyes-exhilarator,

1399.g: ਕੁਨਦ ਪੀਰ ਸਦ ਸਾਲਹ ਰਾ ਨਉ ਜਵਾਨ ॥੫੭॥੩॥
1399.t: kunadh peer sadh saaleh raa nau javaan ||57||3||
1399.e: Which restores the youthful vigour in a hundred year old.(57)

1400.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫ਼ਤਹ ॥
1400.t: ikOankaar vaahaguroo jee kee phateh ||
1400.e: Glory to God

1400.g: ਕਿ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਅਸਤੁ ਰਾਜ਼ਕ ਰਹੀਮ ॥
1400.t: k rozee dhiha(n)dh asat raazak raheem ||
1400.e: The Provider of Living is benevolent,

1400.g: ਰਹਾਈ ਦਿਹੋ ਰਹਿਨੁਮਾਏ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੧॥
1400.t: rahaiee dhiho rahinumaae kareem ||1||
1400.e: He is kind and leads kindly-light.(1)

1400.g: ਦਿਲ ਅਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਇ ਦਾਨਸ਼ ਦਿਹੋ ਦਾਦਗਰ ॥
1400.t: dhil aphazai dhaanash dhiho dhaadhagar ||
1400.e: He is heartening, creates intelligence and renders justice.

1400.g: ਰਜ਼ਾ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਹੋ ਹਰ ਹੁਨਰ ॥੨॥
1400.t: razaa bakhhash rozee dhiho har hunar ||2||
1400.e: Makes us believer and, with subsistence, facilitates our existence.(2)

1400.g: ਹਿਕਾਯਤ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦਮ ਯਕੇ ਨੇਕ ਜ਼ਨ ॥
1400.t: hikaayat shuneedham yake nek zan ||
1400.e: Now listen to the Tale of a kind lady,

1400.g: ਚੁ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ਾਦ ਕੱਦੇ ਬ ਜੋਏ ਚਮਨ ॥੩॥
1400.t: ch shamashaadh ka'dhe b joe chaman ||3||
1400.e: Who was like a cypress tree standing on the bank of a rivulet in the garden.(3)

1400.g: ਕਿ ਓ ਰਾ ਪਦਰ ਰਾਜਹੇ ਉਤਰ ਦੇਸ਼ ॥
1400.t: k o raa padhar raajahe utar dhesh ||
1400.e: Her father ruled over a kingdom in the north.

1400.g: ਬ ਸ਼ੀਰੀਂ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਹਮ ਚ ਇਖ਼ਲਾਸ ਕੇਸ਼ ॥੪॥
1400.t: b sheeree(n) zubaa ham ch ikhhalaas kesh ||4||
1400.e: He was sweet spoken and possessed kind nature.(4)

1400.g: ਕਿ ਆਮਦ ਬਰਾਏ ਹਮਹ ਗ਼ੁਸਲ ਗੰਗ ॥
1400.t: k aamadh baraae hameh g(h)usal ga(n)g ||
1400.e: They all came to bathe in the (river) Ganga.

1400.g: ਚੁ ਕੈਬਰ ਕਮਾ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਤੀਰੇ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥੫॥
1400.t: ch kaibar kamaa ham ch teere tupha(n)g ||5||
1400.e: Like an arrow out of a bow, they were very swift.(5)

1400.g: ਹਮੀ ਖ਼ਾਸਤ ਕਿ ਓ ਰਾ ਸ੍ਵਯੰਬਰ ਕੁਨਮ ॥
1400.t: hamee khhaasat k o raa savaiya(n)bar kunam ||
1400.e: He (King) thought about her betrothal,

1400.g: ਕਸੇ ਈਂ ਪਸੰਦ ਆਯਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਦਿਹਮ ॥੬॥
1400.t: kase iee(n) pasa(n)dh aayadh o raa dhiham ||6||
1400.e: ‘If she revelled some one, I will bequeath her to him.’(6)

1400.g: ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰੇ ਨੇਕ ਤਨ ॥
1400.t: bigoyadh sukhhan dhukhhatare nek tan ||
1400.e: He pronounced, ‘O, my kind daughter,

1400.g: ਕਸੇ ਤੋ ਪਸੰਦ ਆਯਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਬਕੁਨ ॥੭॥
1400.t: kase to pasa(n)dh aayadh o raa bakun ||7||
1400.e: ‘If you fancy some one, let me know.‘(7)

1400.g: ਨਿਸ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਬਰ ਕਾਖ ਓ ਹਫ਼ਤ ਖਨ ॥
1400.t: nishaadha(n)dh bar kaakh o haphat khan ||
1400.e: She was conferred a higher status,

1400.g: ਚੁ ਮਾਹੇ ਮਹੀ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਯਮਨ ॥੮॥
1400.t: ch maahe mahee aaphataabe yaman ||8||
1400.e: So that she looked like the moon shining on Yaman.(8)

1400.g: ਦਹਾਨੇ ਦੁਹਦ ਰਾ ਦਹਨ ਬਰ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਦ ॥
1400.t: dhahaane dhuhadh raa dhahan bar kushaadh ||
1400.e: The musical drums (instruments) were unveiled,

1400.g: ਜਵਾਬੇ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਰਾ ਉਜ਼ਰ ਬਰ ਨਿਹਾਦ ॥੯॥
1400.t: javaabe sukhhan raa uzar bar nihaadh ||9||
1400.e: And the king awaited to hear her reply in consent.(9)

1400.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਰਾਜਹੇ ਰਾਜਹਾ ਬੇਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ॥
1400.t: k iee(n) raajahe raajahaa beshumaar ||
1400.e: Because there had come many kings and kins of kings,

1400.g: ਕਿ ਵਕਤੇ ਤਰੱਦਦ ਬਿਆ ਮੁਖ਼ਤਹਕਾਰ ॥੧੦॥
1400.t: k vakate tara'dhadh biaa mukhhatahakaar ||10||
1400.e: Who were quite adept in the strategies of war.(10)

1400.g: ਕਸੇ ਤੋ ਪਸੰਦ ਆਯਦਤ ਈਂ ਜ਼ਮਾ ॥
1400.t: kase to pasa(n)dh aayadhat iee(n) zamaa ||
1400.e: (King asked), ‘If there is any one of your liking,

1400.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਪਸ ਬ ਦਾਮਾਦੀ ਆਯਦ ਹੁਮਾ ॥੧੧॥
1400.t: vazaa pas b dhaamaadhee aayadh humaa ||11||
1400.e: ‘He will become as my son-in-law.‘(11)

1400.g: ਨੁਮਾਦੰਦ ਬ ਓ ਰਾਜਹਾ ਬੇਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ॥
1400.t: numaadha(n)dh b o raajahaa beshumaar ||
1400.e: She encountered many princes,

1400.g: ਪਸੰਦਸ਼ ਨਿਯਾਮਦ ਕਸੇ ਕਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧੨॥
1400.t: pasa(n)dhash niyaamadh kase kaar baar ||12||
1400.e: But, on account of their feats, she did not like any.(12)

1400.g: ਹਮ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਯਕੇ ਰਾਜਹੇ ਸੁਭਟ ਸਿੰਘ ॥
1400.t: ham aakhhar yake raajahe subhaT si(n)gh ||
1400.e: At last came the one called Subhat Singh,

1400.g: ਪਸੰਦ ਆਮਦਸ਼ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਗੁਰਰਾ ਨਿਹੰਗ ॥੧੩॥
1400.t: pasa(n)dh aamadhash ham ch guraraa niha(n)g ||13||
1400.e: Whom she preferred as he roared like a crocodile.(13)

1400.g: ਹਮਹ ਉਮਦਹੇ ਰਾਜਹਾ ਪੇਸ਼ ਖਾਦ ॥
1400.t: hameh umadhahe raajahaa pesh khaadh ||
1400.e: All the handsome princes were called forward,

1400.g: ਜੁਦਾ ਬਰ ਜੁਦਾ ਦਉਰ ਮਜਲਸ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੧੪॥
1400.t: judhaa bar judhaa dhaur majalas nishaadh ||14||
1400.e: And asked to take their seats around the court.(14)

1400.g: ਬ ਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਕਿ ਏ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰੇ ਨੇਕ ਖ਼ੋਇ ॥
1400.t: b purasheedh k e dhukhhatare nek khhoi ||
1400.e: (The king asked), ‘Oh, my kind daughter,

1400.g: ਤੁਰਾ ਕਸ ਪਸੰਦ ਆਯਦ ਅਜ਼ੀਹਾ ਬਜੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
1400.t: turaa kas pasa(n)dh aayadh azeehaa bajoi ||15||
1400.e: ‘Do you like any one of them, the discoveries of mine.‘(15)

1400.g: ਰਵਾ ਕਰਦੁ ਜ਼ੁਨਾਰ ਦਾਰਾਨ ਪੇਸ਼ ॥
1400.t: ravaa karadh zunaar dhaaraan pesh ||
1400.e: The person with Juneau (priest with sacred thread of Hindus) was sent forward,

1400.g: ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਰਾਜਹੇ ਉੱਤਰ ਦੇਸ਼ ॥੧੬॥
1400.t: bigoyadh k iee(n) raajahe u'tar dhesh ||16||
1400.e: To speak to those princes from the north.(16)

1400.g: ਕਿ ਓ ਨਾਮ ਬਸਤਸ਼ ਬਛਤਰਾ ਮਤੀ ॥
1400.t: k o naam basatash bachhataraa matee ||
1400.e: But the girl, whose name was addressed as Bachtramati,

1400.g: ਚੁ ਮਾਹੇ ਫ਼ਲਕ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਮਹੀ ॥੧੭॥
1400.t: ch maahe phalak aaphataabe mahee ||17||
1400.e: And was like sun on the earth and moon in the sky,(17)

1400.g: ਅਜ਼ੀ ਰਾਜਹਾ ਕਸ ਨਿਯਾਮਦ ਨਜ਼ਰ ॥
1400.t: azee raajahaa kas niyaamadh nazar ||
1400.e: Spoke, ‘None from them suits my eyes.‘

1400.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਪਸ ਅਜ਼ੀਂ ਹਾ ਬੁਬੀਂ ਪੁਰ ਗੁਹਰ ॥੧੮॥
1400.t: vazaa pas azee(n) haa bubee(n) pur guhar ||18||
1400.e: (King) ‘Then, you the gifted one, judge the ones from (the other side).(18)

1400.g: ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕਰਦ ਬਰ ਰਾਜਹਾ ਨਾਜ਼ਨੀਂ ॥
1400.t: nazar karadh bar raajahaa naazanee(n) ||
1400.e: ‘Those ones with delicate features, look at them again.’

1400.g: ਪਸੰਦਸ਼ ਨਿਯਾਮਦ ਕਸੇ ਦਿਲ ਨਗ਼ੀਂ ॥੧੯॥
1400.t: pasa(n)dhash niyaamadh kase dhil nag(h)ee(n) ||19||
1400.e: But there was none of her heart’s liking.(19)

1400.g: ਸ੍ਵਯੰਬਰ ਵਜ਼ਾ ਰੋਜ਼ ਮਉਕੂਫ਼ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥
1400.t: savaiya(n)bar vazaa roz maukooph gashat ||
1400.e: The selection of would-be husband was abandoned,

1400.g: ਕਿ ਨਾਜ਼ਮ ਬੁ ਬਰਖ਼ਾਸਤ ਦਰਵਾਜ਼ਹ ਬਸਤ ॥੨੦॥
1400.t: k naazam b barakhhaasat dharavaazeh basat ||20||
1400.e: And the organisers departed closing the doors.(20)

1400.g: ਕਿ ਰੋਜ਼ੇ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਜ਼ਰਰੀਂ ਸਿਪਹਰ ॥
1400.t: k roze dhig(h)r shaeh zararee(n) sipahar ||
1400.e: The next day came, the King with golden shield,

1400.g: ਬਰ ਅਉਰੰਗ ਬਰਾਮਦ ਚੁ ਰਉਸ਼ਨ ਗੁਹਰ ॥੨੧॥
1400.t: bar aaura(n)g baraamadh ch raushan guhar ||21||
1400.e: Which was shinning like the pearls.(21)

1400.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਹੇ ਰਾਜਹਾ ਖ਼ਾਸਤੰਦ ॥
1400.t: dhig(h)r roz he raajahaa khhaasata(n)dh ||
1400.e: On the second day the princes were invited again,

1400.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਗੂਨਹ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਆਰਾਸਤੰਦ ॥੨੨॥
1400.t: dhig(h)r gooneh baazaar aaraasata(n)dh ||22||
1400.e: And they adorned the court in a different order.(22)

1400.g: ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕੁਨ ਬਰੋਏ ਤੁ ਏ ਦਿਲਰੁਬਾਇ ॥
1400.t: nazar kun baroe ta e dhilarubai ||
1400.e: ‘Oh, my cherished one, look at those faces,

1400.g: ਕਿਰਾ ਤੋ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਦਰ ਬਿਯਾਯਦ ਬਜਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
1400.t: kiraa to nazar dhar biyaayadh bajai ||23||
1400.e: ‘Whom so ever you like, you will be wedded to.‘(23)

1400.g: ਬ ਪਹਿਨ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਗੁਲੇ ਅੰਜਮਨ ॥
1400.t: b pahin a(n)dhar aamadh gule a(n)jaman ||
1400.e: ‘In the courtyard, she entered the enclosure,
